          <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-taupe font-sans block">
            Executive Summary
          </span>
          <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl text-charcoal">
            Store Performance &amp; Contribution
          </h1>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link href="/admin/products" className="btn-boutique-primary py-2.5 px-4 text-xs">
            + Add Product
          </Link>
          <Link href="/admin/settings" className="btn-boutique-secondary py-2.5 px-4 text-xs">
            Pricing Settings
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 1. FINANCIAL METRICS GRID */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5">
        
        {/* Gross Revenue */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] p-5 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-taupe">
            <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-sans font-medium">Total Revenue</span>
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-taupe-dark" />
          </div>
          <p className="font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal font-semibold">
            ₹{financial.totalRevenue.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-charcoal/60 font-sans">
            From {financial.paidOrdersCount} paid boutique transactions
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Total Supplier Costs */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] p-5 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-taupe">
            <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-sans font-medium">Supplier Cost</span>
            <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-taupe-dark" />
          </div>
          <p className="font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal font-semibold">
            ₹{financial.totalSupplierCost.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-charcoal/60 font-sans">
            Strictly confidential &bull; Kept private via RLS
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Total Fulfillment Expenses (Shipping + Gateway) */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] p-5 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-taupe">
            <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-sans font-medium">Operating Expenses</span>
            <Truck className="w-4 h-4 text-taupe-dark" />
          </div>
          <p className="font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal font-semibold">
            ₹{(financial.totalActualShippingExpenses + financial.totalGatewayCharges + financial.packagingExpenses).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-charcoal/60 font-sans">
            Shipping (₹{financial.totalActualShippingExpenses}) + Gateway (₹{financial.totalGatewayCharges}) + Boxes (₹{financial.packagingExpenses})
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Net Contribution Margin */}
        <div className="bg-ivory/60 border border-champagne p-5 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-taupe-dark">
            <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-sans font-medium">Net Contribution</span>
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" />
          </div>
          <p className="font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal font-semibold">
            ₹{financial.netContribution.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-emerald-800 font-sans font-medium">
            <Percent className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Margin: {financial.contributionMarginPercent}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* 2. PRICING ENGINE LIVE RULE BANNER */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-champagne p-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-ivory flex items-center justify-center text-taupe-dark shrink-0">
            <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-serif text-lg text-charcoal">
              Active Dynamic Pricing Engine Rule
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-charcoal/70 font-sans">
              Default Markup: <strong className="text-charcoal font-semibold">₹{financial.currentDefaultMarkup}</strong> &bull; Selling Price = Verified Supplier Cost + ₹{financial.currentDefaultMarkup}.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Link
          href="/admin/settings"
          className="btn-boutique-secondary py-2 px-4 text-xs font-sans whitespace-nowrap"
        >
          Adjust Markup Rule &rarr;
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* 3. RECENT ORDERS & BESTSELLERS GRID */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-start">
        
        {/* Recent Orders (7 cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] p-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-3">
            <h2 className="font-serif text-xl text-charcoal">Recent Boutique Orders</h2>
            <Link href="/admin/orders" className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-taupe hover:text-charcoal font-sans">
              View All ({allOrders.length})

          </div>

          <div className="divide-y divide-[#EBE3D8]/60 overflow-x-auto">
            {recentOrders.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-8 text-center text-taupe text-xs font-sans">
                No customer orders placed yet. Live orders will appear here automatically when shoppers check out.
              </div>
            ) : (
              recentOrders.map((ord) => (
                <div key={ord.id} className="py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs font-sans">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-medium text-charcoal block">#{ord.order_number}</span>
                    <span className="text-charcoal/60">{ord.customer.name} &bull; {ord.customer.city}</span>
                  </div>

                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe block mt-0.5">
                      {ord.payment_status === "paid" ? "Paid (Prepaid)" : "Pending"}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right">
                    <span className="font-medium text-charcoal block">₹{ord.total_payable.toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-800">
                      Profit: +₹{ord.total_contribution}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Bestselling Products (5 cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] p-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-3">
            <h2 className="font-serif text-xl text-charcoal">Bestselling Pieces</h2>
            <Link href="/admin/products" className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-taupe hover:text-charcoal font-sans">
              Manage
            </Link>
          </div>

          <div className="divide-y divide-[#EBE3D8]/60">
            {bestsellers.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-8 text-center text-taupe text-xs font-sans space-y-2">
                <p>No products in catalogue yet.</p>
                <Link href="/admin/products" className="btn-boutique-primary py-1.5 px-3 text-[11px] inline-block">
                  ⚡ Quick Add by Link
                </Link>
              </div>
            ) : (
              bestsellers.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs font-sans">
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-serif text-sm text-charcoal line-clamp-1">{item.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-taupe uppercase tracking-wider">
                      {item.category} &bull; Stock: {item.stock}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                    <span className="font-medium text-charcoal block">₹{item.selling_price}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe block">
                      Cost: ₹{item.supplier_cost}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Product, ProductCategory, ProductSubcategory } from "@/lib/types";
import { CATEGORIES_DATA } from "@/data/seed-data";
import {
  Plus,
  Edit2,
  Trash2,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Sparkles,
  AlertCircle,
  Link as LinkIcon,
  CheckCircle2,
  ExternalLink,
  Loader2,
  ArrowRight,
  RefreshCw,
} from "lucide-react";
import { calculateSellingPrice } from "@/lib/pricing-engine";

const getCategorySubcategories = (catSlug: string) => {
  const cat = CATEGORIES_DATA.find((c) => c.slug === catSlug);
  return cat ? cat.subcategories : [];
};

export default function AdminProductsPage() {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingProduct, setEditingProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);

  // Link Importer State
  const [linkUrl, setLinkUrl] = useState("");
  const [directImageUrl, setDirectImageUrl] = useState("");
  const [extracting, setExtracting] = useState(false);
  const [extractError, setExtractError] = useState("");
  const [quickCost, setQuickCost] = useState<number>(250);
  const [quickPrice, setQuickPrice] = useState<number>(300); // Auto +₹50
  const [quickHottest, setQuickHottest] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [adminTableFilter, setAdminTableFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [isCustomCategoryQuick, setIsCustomCategoryQuick] = useState(false);
  const [customCategoryQuick, setCustomCategoryQuick] = useState("");
  const [isCustomSubcategoryQuick, setIsCustomSubcategoryQuick] = useState(false);
  const [customSubcategoryQuick, setCustomSubcategoryQuick] = useState("");

  const [isCustomCategoryModal, setIsCustomCategoryModal] = useState(false);
  const [customCategoryModal, setCustomCategoryModal] = useState("");
  const [isCustomSubcategoryModal, setIsCustomSubcategoryModal] = useState(false);
  const [customSubcategoryModal, setCustomSubcategoryModal] = useState("");

  const [extractedData, setExtractedData] = useState<{
    name: string;
    description: string;
    image_url: string;
    category: ProductCategory;
    subcategory: ProductSubcategory;
    isExtracted: boolean;
  } | null>(null);
  const [publishing, setPublishing] = useState(false);
  const [publishedItem, setPublishedItem] = useState<{
    name: string;
    slug: string;
    price: number;
  } | null>(null);

  // Manual Form State
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: "",
    category: "jewellery" as ProductCategory,
    subcategory: "earrings" as ProductSubcategory,
    description: "",
    supplier_cost: 250,
    custom_markup: null as number | null,
    stock: 20,
    image_url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535632066927-ab7c9ab60908?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80",
    is_featured: false,
    is_bestseller: false,
    is_new: true,
    is_visible: true,
    tags: "pearl, earrings, handcrafted",
  });

  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  const loadProducts = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/products");
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        setProducts(data.products || []);
      }
    } catch {
      // fallback
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProducts();
  }, []);

  // Update quick price automatically when supplier cost changes (+₹50 rule)
  const handleCostChange = (newCost: number) => {
    setQuickCost(newCost);
    setQuickPrice(newCost + 50);
  };

  // Handle URL Link Extraction
  const handleExtractLink = async (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!linkUrl.trim()) {
      setExtractError("Please paste a valid product link or URL.");
      return;
    }

    setExtracting(true);
    setExtractError("");
    setPublishedItem(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/extract-link", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          url: linkUrl.trim(),
          directImageUrl: directImageUrl.trim() || undefined,
        }),
      });

      const json = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && json.data) {
        const catSlug = json.data.category;
        const subSlug = json.data.subcategory;
        const isStandardCat = CATEGORIES_DATA.some((c) => c.slug === catSlug);
        setIsCustomCategoryQuick(!isStandardCat);
        setCustomCategoryQuick(!isStandardCat ? catSlug : "");

        const subcats = getCategorySubcategories(catSlug);
        const isStandardSub = subcats.some((s) => s.slug === subSlug);
        setIsCustomSubcategoryQuick(!isStandardSub);
        setCustomSubcategoryQuick(!isStandardSub ? subSlug : "");

        setExtractedData({
          name: json.data.name,
          description: json.data.description,
          image_url: json.data.image_url,
          category: json.data.category,
          subcategory: json.data.subcategory,
          isExtracted: json.isExtracted,
        });
      } else {
        setExtractError(json.error || "Could not read link. You can still enter details manually.");
      }
    } catch {
      setExtractError("Network error while inspecting link.");
    } finally {
      setExtracting(false);
    }
  };

  // Publish extracted product immediately live to storefront
  const handlePublishFromLink = async () => {
    if (!extractedData) return;
    if (!extractedData.name.trim()) {
      setExtractError("Product name cannot be empty.");
      return;
    }

    setPublishing(true);
    setExtractError("");

    try {
      const customMarkup = quickPrice - quickCost;
      const payload = {
        name: extractedData.name.trim(),
        category: extractedData.category,
        subcategory: extractedData.subcategory,
        description: extractedData.description,
        supplier_cost: Number(quickCost),
        custom_markup: customMarkup !== 50 ? customMarkup : null,
        stock: 25,
        is_featured: true,
        is_bestseller: quickHottest,
        is_new: true,
        is_visible: true,
        product_link: linkUrl.trim() || undefined,
        source_url: linkUrl.trim() || undefined,
        tags: [extractedData.category, extractedData.subcategory, "new arrival", "link imported"],
        images: [
          {
            id: `img-${Date.now()}`,
            image_url: extractedData.image_url,
            alt_text: extractedData.name,
            display_order: 1,
            is_primary: true,
          },
        ],
      };

      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/products", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && data.product) {
        setPublishedItem({
          name: data.product.name,
          slug: data.product.slug,
          price: data.product.selling_price,
        });
        setExtractedData(null);
        setLinkUrl("");
        setDirectImageUrl("");
        setQuickHottest(false);
        loadProducts();
      } else {
        setExtractError(data.error || "Failed to publish product.");
      }
    } catch {
      setExtractError("Network error while publishing product.");
    } finally {
      setPublishing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleHottest = async (product: Product) => {
    try {
      const updated = {
        ...product,
        is_bestseller: !product.is_bestseller,
      };
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/products", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(updated),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setProducts((prev) =>
          prev.map((p) => (p.id === product.id ? { ...p, is_bestseller: !p.is_bestseller } : p))
        );
      }
    } catch {
      alert("Failed to update product.");
    }
  };

  const openAddModal = () => {
    setEditingProduct(null);
    setIsCustomCategoryModal(false);
    setCustomCategoryModal("");
    setIsCustomSubcategoryModal(false);
    setCustomSubcategoryModal("");
    setFormData({
      name: "",
      category: "press-on-nails",
      subcategory: "press-on-nails",
      description: "",
      supplier_cost: 250,
      custom_markup: null,
      stock: 20,
      image_url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1632345031435-8727f6897d53?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80",
      is_featured: false,
      is_bestseller: false,
      is_new: true,
      is_visible: true,
      tags: "nails, press-on, handcrafted, boutique",
    });
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const openEditModal = (p: Product) => {
    setEditingProduct(p);
    const isStandardCat = CATEGORIES_DATA.some((c) => c.slug === p.category);
    setIsCustomCategoryModal(!isStandardCat);
    setCustomCategoryModal(!isStandardCat ? p.category : "");

    const subcats = getCategorySubcategories(p.category);
    const isStandardSub = subcats.some((s) => s.slug === p.subcategory);
    setIsCustomSubcategoryModal(!isStandardSub);
    setCustomSubcategoryModal(!isStandardSub ? p.subcategory : "");

    setFormData({
      name: p.name,
      category: p.category,
      subcategory: p.subcategory,
      description: p.description,
      supplier_cost: p.supplier_cost,
      custom_markup: p.custom_markup ?? null,
      stock: p.stock,
      image_url: p.images[0]?.image_url || "",
      is_featured: p.is_featured,
      is_bestseller: p.is_bestseller,
      is_new: p.is_new,
      is_visible: p.is_visible,
      tags: p.tags.join(", "),
    });
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const calculatedSellingPrice = calculateSellingPrice(
    formData.supplier_cost,
    formData.custom_markup
  );

  const handleSaveProduct = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const payload = {
        id: editingProduct?.id,
        name: formData.name,
        category: formData.category,
        subcategory: formData.subcategory,
        description: formData.description,
        supplier_cost: Number(formData.supplier_cost),
        custom_markup: formData.custom_markup !== null ? Number(formData.custom_markup) : null,
        stock: Number(formData.stock),
        is_featured: formData.is_featured,
        is_bestseller: formData.is_bestseller,
        is_new: formData.is_new,
        is_visible: formData.is_visible,
        tags: formData.tags.split(",").map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean),
        images: [
          {
            id: `img-${Date.now()}`,
            image_url: formData.image_url,
            alt_text: formData.name,
            display_order: 1,
            is_primary: true,
          },
        ],
      };

      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/products", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        setModalOpen(false);
        loadProducts();
      } else {
        setMessage(data.error || "Failed to save product.");
      }
    } catch {
      setMessage("Network error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteProduct = async (id: string, name: string) => {
    if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${name}?`)) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products?id=${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (res.ok) {
        setProducts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
      }
    } catch {
      alert("Failed to delete product.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      
      {/* Top Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-4">
        <div>
          <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-taupe font-sans block">
            Inventory &amp; Pricing Automation
          </span>
          <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl text-charcoal">
            Product Catalogue ({products.length})
          </h1>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={openAddModal}
          className="btn-boutique-secondary py-2.5 px-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Manual Add</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* ⚡ FEATURE: QUICK ADD BY PRODUCT LINK (AUTO +₹50 & INSTANT PUBLISH)        */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-ivory/30 to-[#FAF6F0] border-2 border-champagne p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-sm space-y-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-champagne/60 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-champagne/40 flex items-center justify-center text-taupe-dark">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal">
                Quick Add by Product Link
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-charcoal/70 font-sans">
                Paste any external product link, set your supplier cost, and publish live to the storefront in one click.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-[11px] font-medium font-sans">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
            Dynamic +₹50 Markup Engine Active
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Success Alert when product is published */}
        {publishedItem && (
          <div className="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-300 p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs font-sans text-emerald-900 animate-fadeIn">

              <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />

                  ✨ &quot;{publishedItem.name}&quot; is now LIVE on your website!

                <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-800">
                  Published at <strong>₹{publishedItem.price}</strong> across Homepage, Shop, Category, and Search.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <Link
              href={`/product/${publishedItem.slug}`}
              target="_blank"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-800 text-white hover:bg-emerald-900 transition-colors text-xs font-medium shrink-0"
            >
              <span>View Live Product</span>
              <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Error Alert */}
        {extractError && (
          <div className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 p-3 text-xs text-rose-800 flex items-center gap-2 font-sans">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{extractError}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Link Input Row */}
        <form onSubmit={handleExtractLink} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-3 items-end">
            <div className="md:col-span-6 space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-charcoal font-semibold font-sans">
                Product Link / URL *
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-taupe">
                  <LinkIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  required
                  value={linkUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setLinkUrl(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Paste link (e.g. Nykaa, Myntra, Amazon, supplier URL)..."
                  className="w-full bg-white border border-champagne pl-9 pr-3 py-3 text-xs text-charcoal placeholder:text-taupe focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal font-sans"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="md:col-span-4 space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-charcoal font-semibold font-sans">
                Product Image Link (Optional)
              </label>
              <input
                type="url"
                value={directImageUrl}
                onChange={(e) => setDirectImageUrl(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Paste direct image link if you copied it..."
                className="w-full bg-white border border-champagne px-3 py-3 text-xs text-charcoal placeholder:text-taupe focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal font-sans"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={extracting || !linkUrl.trim()}
                className="btn-boutique-primary w-full py-3 px-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-sans disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {extracting ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Reading...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Add by Link</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Interactive Editor Card after link inspection */}
        {extractedData && (
          <div className="bg-white border border-champagne p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-6 shadow-sm font-sans animate-fadeIn">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-3">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-charcoal flex items-center gap-2">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                {extractedData.isExtracted
                  ? "Product Information & Image Ready"
                  : "Link Detected — Review & Set Price"}
              </span>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setExtractedData(null)}

              >
                Discard
              </button>
            </div>

              {/* Left Column: Image Preview & URL */}

                    <Image
                      src={extractedData.image_url}
                      alt={extractedData.name || "Preview"}

                      unoptimized
                      referrerPolicy="no-referrer"

                    />

                    <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-taupe text-xs">
                      No Image URL
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-charcoal font-medium">
                    Product Image URL
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="url"
                    value={extractedData.image_url}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, image_url: e.target.value })

                  />

                <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-taupe font-sans font-medium block">
                    Or Pick Studio Aesthetic Photo:
                  </span>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-sans">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, image_url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1632345031435-8727f6897d53?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80" })}
                      className="p-1.5 border border-champagne bg-ivory/40 hover:bg-white text-charcoal text-left truncate flex items-center gap-1"
                    >
                      <span>💅 Glazed Nails</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, image_url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535632066927-ab7c9ab60908?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80" })}
                      className="p-1.5 border border-champagne bg-ivory/40 hover:bg-white text-charcoal text-left truncate flex items-center gap-1"
                    >
                      <span>✨ Baroque Drops</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, image_url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1599643478518-a784e5dc4c8f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80" })}
                      className="p-1.5 border border-champagne bg-ivory/40 hover:bg-white text-charcoal text-left truncate flex items-center gap-1"
                    >
                      <span>✨ Pearl Choker</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, image_url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1606760227091-3dd870d97f1d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80" })}
                      className="p-1.5 border border-champagne bg-ivory/40 hover:bg-white text-charcoal text-left truncate flex items-center gap-1"

                        const val = e.target.value;
                        if (val === "__custom__") {
                          setIsCustomCategoryQuick(true);
                          const fallback = customCategoryQuick || "custom-category";
                          setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, category: fallback as ProductCategory });
                        } else {
                          setIsCustomCategoryQuick(false);
                          const subcats = getCategorySubcategories(val);
                          const firstSub = subcats[0]?.slug || "general";
                          setIsCustomSubcategoryQuick(false);
                          setExtractedData({
                            ...extractedData,
                            category: val as ProductCategory,
                            subcategory: firstSub as ProductSubcategory,
                          });
                        }
                      }}
                      className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {CATEGORIES_DATA.map((cat) => (
                        <option key={cat.slug} value={cat.slug}>
                          {cat.name}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                      <option value="__custom__">➕ + Add Custom Category...</option>
                    </select>

                    {isCustomCategoryQuick && (
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={customCategoryQuick}

                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const typed = e.target.value;
                          setCustomCategoryQuick(typed);
                          const slug = typed.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-") || "custom-category";
                          setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, category: slug as ProductCategory });
                        }}
                        className="w-full mt-1 bg-white border border-champagne p-2 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal font-sans"
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-charcoal font-medium">

                    </label>
                    <select

                        const val = e.target.value;
                        if (val === "__custom__") {
                          setIsCustomSubcategoryQuick(true);
                          const fallback = customSubcategoryQuick || "custom-item";
                          setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, subcategory: fallback as ProductSubcategory });
                        } else {
                          setIsCustomSubcategoryQuick(false);
                          setExtractedData({
                            ...extractedData,
                            subcategory: val as ProductSubcategory,

                        }
                      }}
                      className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {getCategorySubcategories(extractedData.category).map((sub) => (

                        type="text"
                        value={customSubcategoryQuick}

                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const typed = e.target.value;
                          setCustomSubcategoryQuick(typed);
                          const slug = typed.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-") || "custom-item";
                          setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, subcategory: slug as ProductSubcategory });
                        }}
                        className="w-full mt-1 bg-white border border-champagne p-2 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal font-sans"

                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Hottest Pick Toggle in Quick Add */}
                <div className="bg-white/80 border border-champagne p-3">
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer select-none">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={quickHottest}
                      onChange={(e) => setQuickHottest(e.target.checked)}
                      className="accent-charcoal rounded-none w-4 h-4 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <span className="text-xs text-charcoal font-medium font-sans flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span>🔥 Feature in &quot;Hottest Picks&quot; Collection</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe font-normal">(Displays in Hottest Picks section on Homepage &amp; Shop)</span>
                    </span>
                  </label>
                </div>

                {/* Dynamic Pricing Engine Calculation Card */}
                <div className="bg-[#FAF7F2] border border-champagne p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-charcoal flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-taupe-dark" />
                      Dynamic Pricing Engine: Selling Price = Cost + ₹50
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-800 font-mono font-medium">
                      Margin: ₹{quickPrice - quickCost}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-charcoal font-medium">
                        Supplier Cost (₹)
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        value={quickCost}
                        onChange={(e) => handleCostChange(Number(e.target.value) || 0)}
                        className="w-full bg-white border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
                      />
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-taupe block">
                        Confidential &bull; Scrubbed from public views
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-charcoal font-medium">
                        Selling Price (₹) &bull; Live On Site
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        value={quickPrice}
                        onChange={(e) => setQuickPrice(Number(e.target.value) || 0)}
                        className="w-full bg-white border border-champagne p-2.5 text-sm font-semibold font-mono text-emerald-800 focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
                      />
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-emerald-700 block">
                        Default: Cost (₹{quickCost}) + ₹50 = ₹{quickCost + 50}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Description */}
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-charcoal font-medium">
                    Product Description
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={3}
                    value={extractedData.description}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setExtractedData({ ...extractedData, description: e.target.value })
                    }
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal leading-relaxed"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Action Button: Publish Live */}
                <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setExtractedData(null)}
                    className="btn-boutique-secondary py-3 px-5 text-xs"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={publishing}
                    onClick={handlePublishFromLink}
                    className="btn-boutique-primary py-3 px-6 text-xs flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {publishing ? (
                      <>
                        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                        <span>Publishing to Website...</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>Publish Live to Website Now &rarr;</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>

              </div>

            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* EXISTING PRODUCT CATALOGUE TABLE                                          */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[#EBE3D8] flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-serif text-lg text-charcoal">
              All Storefront Products ({products.length})
            </h3>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 mt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTableFilter("all")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans border transition-all ${
                  adminTableFilter === "all"
                    ? "bg-charcoal text-white border-charcoal font-medium shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-white text-charcoal/70 border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne"
                }`}
              >
                All ({products.length})
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTableFilter("hottest")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans border transition-all flex items-center gap-1 ${
                  adminTableFilter === "hottest"
                    ? "bg-[#2D2A26] text-[#FAF8F5] border-[#2D2A26] font-medium shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-white text-[#C2714F] border-champagne hover:border-charcoal font-medium"
                }`}
              >
                <span>🔥 Hottest Picks</span>
                <span>({products.filter((p) => p.is_bestseller).length})</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTableFilter("press-on-nails")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans border transition-all ${
                  adminTableFilter === "press-on-nails"
                    ? "bg-charcoal text-white border-charcoal font-medium shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-white text-charcoal/70 border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne"

              >
                Press-On Nails ({products.filter((p) => p.category === "press-on-nails").length})
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTableFilter("hair-accessories")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans border transition-all ${

                    : "bg-white text-charcoal/70 border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne"

              >
                Hair Clips ({products.filter((p) => p.category === "hair-accessories").length})
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTableFilter("jewellery")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans border transition-all ${
                  adminTableFilter === "jewellery"
                    ? "bg-charcoal text-white border-charcoal font-medium shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-white text-charcoal/70 border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne"
                }`}
              >
                Jewellery ({products.filter((p) => p.category === "jewellery").length})
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTableFilter("everyday-essentials")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans border transition-all ${
                  adminTableFilter === "everyday-essentials"
                    ? "bg-charcoal text-white border-charcoal font-medium shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-white text-charcoal/70 border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne"

              >
                Everyday ({products.filter((p) => p.category === "everyday-essentials").length})
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTableFilter("bags-pouches")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans border transition-all ${
                  adminTableFilter === "bags-pouches"
                    ? "bg-charcoal text-white border-charcoal font-medium shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-white text-charcoal/70 border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne"
                }`}
              >
                Bags ({products.filter((p) => p.category === "bags-pouches").length})
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTableFilter("eyewear")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans border transition-all ${
                  adminTableFilter === "eyewear"
                    ? "bg-charcoal text-white border-charcoal font-medium shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-white text-charcoal/70 border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne"

                Eyewear ({products.filter((p) => p.category === "eyewear").length})

                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdminTableFilter("gifts")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans border transition-all ${
                  adminTableFilter === "gifts"
                    ? "bg-charcoal text-white border-charcoal font-medium shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-white text-charcoal/70 border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne"
                }`}
              >
                Gifts ({products.filter((p) => p.category === "gifts").length})
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadProducts}
            className="text-xs text-taupe hover:text-charcoal flex items-center gap-1 font-sans shrink-0"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" />

              <tr>
                <th className="p-4">Item</th>
                <th className="p-4">Category</th>
                <th className="p-4">Supplier Cost</th>
                <th className="p-4">Selling Price</th>
                <th className="p-4">Stock</th>
                <th className="p-4">Hottest Pick</th>

                  <td colSpan={8} className="p-8 text-center text-taupe">

                  </td>

                    No products found. Add your first piece using the link importer above.

                  .filter((p) => {
                    if (adminTableFilter === "hottest") return p.is_bestseller;
                    if (adminTableFilter !== "all") return p.category === adminTableFilter;
                    return true;

                          <Link

                          <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe font-mono block">

                          {(p.product_link || p.source_url) && (

                              href={p.product_link || p.source_url}

                              rel="noopener noreferrer"
                              className="text-[10px] text-taupe hover:text-charcoal underline inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 mt-0.5 font-sans"
                            >
                              <span>Source Link</span>
                              <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                            </a>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Category */}
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <span className="capitalize">{p.category.replace("-", " ")}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe block capitalize">
                        {p.subcategory === "claw-clips" ? "Claw Clip (Hair Clip)" : p.subcategory.replace("-", " ")}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Supplier Cost */}
                    <td className="p-4 font-mono">
                      ₹{p.supplier_cost}
                    </td>

                    {/* Selling Price */}
                    <td className="p-4 font-medium font-mono text-emerald-800">
                      ₹{p.selling_price}
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe block font-sans">
                        Markup: +₹{p.selling_price - p.supplier_cost}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Stock */}
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <span
                        className={`inline-block px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${
                          p.stock > 5
                            ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200"
                            : p.stock > 0
                            ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200"
                            : "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {p.stock} in stock
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Hottest Pick 1-Click Toggle */}
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleToggleHottest(p)}
                        className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-sans transition-all inline-flex items-center gap-1 border ${
                          p.is_bestseller
                            ? "bg-[#2D2A26] text-[#FAF8F5] border-[#2D2A26] font-medium shadow-xs"
                            : "bg-white text-taupe border-[#EBE3D8] hover:text-charcoal hover:border-champagne"
                        }`}
                        title={p.is_bestseller ? "Click to unmark from Hottest Picks" : "Click to mark as Hottest Pick"}
                      >
                        <span>🔥</span>
                        <span>{p.is_bestseller ? "Hottest" : "Standard"}</span>
                      </button>
                    </td>

                    {/* Visibility */}
                    <td className="p-4">
                      {p.is_visible ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700 text-[11px]">
                          <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Visible
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-gray-400 text-[11px]">
                          <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Hidden
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Actions */}
                    <td className="p-4 text-right space-x-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => openEditModal(p)}
                        className="p-1.5 text-charcoal/70 hover:text-charcoal transition-colors border border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne"
                        title="Edit piece"
                      >
                        <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteProduct(p.id, p.name)}
                        className="p-1.5 text-taupe hover:text-rose-700 transition-colors border border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-rose-200"
                        title="Delete piece"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </td>

                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* MANUAL ADD / EDIT MODAL                                                   */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {modalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-y-auto bg-charcoal/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] w-full max-w-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6 shadow-2xl">
            
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-3">
              <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal">
                {editingProduct ? "Edit Product" : "Add New Boutique Product"}
              </h2>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-taupe hover:text-charcoal text-xs uppercase"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>

            {message && (
              <div className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 p-3 text-xs text-rose-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{message}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSaveProduct} className="space-y-4 text-xs font-sans">
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="sm:col-span-2 space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Product Title *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="e.g. Freshwater Baroque Pearl Choker"
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Category *
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={isCustomCategoryModal ? "__custom__" : formData.category}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const val = e.target.value;
                      if (val === "__custom__") {
                        setIsCustomCategoryModal(true);
                        const fallback = customCategoryModal || "custom-category";
                        setFormData({ ...formData, category: fallback as ProductCategory });
                      } else {
                        setIsCustomCategoryModal(false);
                        const subcats = getCategorySubcategories(val);
                        const firstSub = subcats[0]?.slug || "general";
                        setIsCustomSubcategoryModal(false);
                        setFormData({
                          ...formData,
                          category: val as ProductCategory,
                          subcategory: firstSub as ProductSubcategory,
                        });
                      }
                    }}
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {CATEGORIES_DATA.map((cat) => (
                      <option key={cat.slug} value={cat.slug}>
                        {cat.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                    <option value="__custom__">➕ + Add Custom Category...</option>
                  </select>

                  {isCustomCategoryModal && (
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={customCategoryModal}
                      placeholder="Type custom category (e.g. Phone Cases, Brooches)..."
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const typed = e.target.value;
                        setCustomCategoryModal(typed);
                        const slug = typed.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-") || "custom-category";
                        setFormData({ ...formData, category: slug as ProductCategory });
                      }}
                      className="w-full mt-1 bg-white border border-champagne p-2 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal font-sans"
                    />
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Subcategory *
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={isCustomSubcategoryModal ? "__custom__" : formData.subcategory}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const val = e.target.value;
                      if (val === "__custom__") {
                        setIsCustomSubcategoryModal(true);
                        const fallback = customSubcategoryModal || "custom-item";
                        setFormData({ ...formData, subcategory: fallback as ProductSubcategory });
                      } else {
                        setIsCustomSubcategoryModal(false);
                        setFormData({
                          ...formData,
                          subcategory: val as ProductSubcategory,
                        });
                      }
                    }}
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {getCategorySubcategories(formData.category).map((sub) => (
                      <option key={sub.slug} value={sub.slug}>
                        {sub.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                    <option value="__custom__">➕ + Add Custom Subcategory...</option>
                  </select>

                  {isCustomSubcategoryModal && (
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={customSubcategoryModal}
                      placeholder="Type custom subcategory (e.g. Nail Stickers, Hair Sticks)..."
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const typed = e.target.value;
                        setCustomSubcategoryModal(typed);
                        const slug = typed.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-") || "custom-item";
                        setFormData({ ...formData, subcategory: slug as ProductSubcategory });
                      }}
                      className="w-full mt-1 bg-white border border-champagne p-2 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal font-sans"
                    />
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* PRICING ENGINE CALCULATION BOX */}
                <div className="sm:col-span-2 bg-ivory/60 border border-champagne p-4 space-y-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-charcoal flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-taupe-dark" />
                    Automated Pricing Engine
                  </span>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Supplier Cost (₹) *
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        required
                        value={formData.supplier_cost}
                        onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, supplier_cost: Number(e.target.value) })}
                        className="w-full bg-white border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
                      />
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe block">
                        Confidential &bull; Never visible to customer
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Calculated Selling Price (₹)
                      </label>
                      <div className="w-full bg-white border border-champagne p-2.5 text-sm font-semibold font-mono text-emerald-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span>₹{calculatedSellingPrice}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-sans font-normal text-taupe">
                          (Cost + ₹{calculatedSellingPrice - formData.supplier_cost} Markup)
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe block">
                        Customer sees this exact price
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Stock Quantity *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    required
                    value={formData.stock}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, stock: Number(e.target.value) })}
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Image URL *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="url"
                    required
                    value={formData.image_url}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, image_url: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="sm:col-span-2 space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Tags (Comma separated)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.tags}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, tags: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="sm:col-span-2 space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Description *
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={3}
                    required
                    value={formData.description}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal leading-relaxed"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="sm:col-span-2 flex flex-wrap gap-6 pt-2">
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={formData.is_featured}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, is_featured: e.target.checked })}
                      className="accent-charcoal"
                    />
                    <span>Featured Piece</span>
                  </label>

                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={formData.is_bestseller}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, is_bestseller: e.target.checked })}
                      className="accent-charcoal"
                    />
                    <span>Bestseller</span>
                  </label>

                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={formData.is_new}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, is_new: e.target.checked })}
                      className="accent-charcoal"
                    />
                    <span>New Arrival</span>
                  </label>

                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={formData.is_visible}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, is_visible: e.target.checked })}
                      className="accent-charcoal"
                    />

                  </label>

              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-[#EBE3D8]">

                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                  className="btn-boutique-secondary py-2.5 px-4 text-xs"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="btn-boutique-primary py-2.5 px-6 text-xs flex items-center gap-2"
                >
                  {saving ? "Saving Piece..." : editingProduct ? "Update Piece" : "Add to Boutique"}
                </button>
              </div>

            </form>

          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Sparkles, Check, AlertCircle, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";

export default function AdminSettingsPage() {
  const [markup, setMarkup] = useState(50);
  const [freeShippingThreshold, setFreeShippingThreshold] = useState(999);
  const [flatShippingFee, setFlatShippingFee] = useState(99);
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState(
    "Complimentary boutique packaging on all prepaid orders | Free shipping over ₹999"
  );
  
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const loadSettings = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/settings");
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && data.settings) {
        setMarkup(data.settings.defaultMarkup || 100);
        setFreeShippingThreshold(data.settings.freeShippingThreshold || 999);
        setFlatShippingFee(data.settings.flatShippingFee || 99);
      }
    } catch {
      // fallback
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSettings();
  }, []);

  const handleUpdateMarkup = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/settings", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ defaultMarkup: markup }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && data.success) {
        setMessage(
          `Success! Default markup updated to ₹${data.newMarkup}. Recalculated prices for ${data.updatedCount} products.`
        );
      } else {
        setError(data.error || "Failed to update markup settings.");
      }
    } catch {
      setError("Network error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl space-y-8">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-4">
        <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-taupe font-sans block">
          Configuration &amp; Pricing Rule
        </span>
        <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl text-charcoal">
          Global Boutique Settings
        </h1>
      </div>

      {message && (
        <div className="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 p-4 text-xs font-sans text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Check className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 p-4 text-xs font-sans text-rose-800 flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 1. DYNAMIC PRICING ENGINE CONFIGURATION */}
      <div className="bg-white border-2 border-champagne p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-champagne pb-4">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-ivory flex items-center justify-center text-taupe-dark">
            <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-serif text-xl text-charcoal">
              Automated Pricing Rule &amp; Default Markup
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-charcoal/70 font-sans">
              Rule: <code className="bg-ivory px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-charcoal font-semibold">Selling Price = Supplier Cost + Markup</code>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleUpdateMarkup} className="space-y-4 text-xs font-sans">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
              Default Markup Amount (₹)
            </label>
            <div className="flex max-w-xs">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center px-3 bg-ivory border border-r-0 border-champagne text-charcoal font-medium">
                ₹
              </span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min="0"
                step="5"
                required
                value={markup}
                onChange={(e) => setMarkup(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-3 text-sm font-semibold font-mono text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
              />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-taupe leading-relaxed pt-1 font-light">
              Modifying this value will instantly recalculate customer selling prices across the catalogue for all products that do not have custom price overrides. Supplier costs remain strictly confidential and hidden from customers.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-2">
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={saving}
              className="btn-boutique-primary py-3 px-6 text-xs flex items-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${saving ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              <span>{saving ? "Recalculating Catalogue..." : `Apply ₹${markup} Markup Globally`}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>

      {/* 2. SHIPPING & ANNOUNCEMENT SETTINGS */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6 shadow-sm">
        <h2 className="font-serif text-xl text-charcoal border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-3">
          Shipping &amp; Logistics Rules
        </h2>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs font-sans">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
              Free Shipping Threshold (₹)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={freeShippingThreshold}
              onChange={(e) => setFreeShippingThreshold(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal font-mono focus:outline-none"
            />
            <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe block">Orders at or above this amount receive free shipping</span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
              Flat Shipping Fee (₹)
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={flatShippingFee}
              onChange={(e) => setFlatShippingFee(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal font-mono focus:outline-none"
            />
            <span className="text-[10px] text-taupe block">Charged on domestic orders below threshold</span>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-2 space-y-1">
            <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
              Announcement Bar Text
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={announcement}
              onChange={(e) => setAnnouncement(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMessage("Shipping settings updated in session.")}
            className="btn-boutique-secondary py-2.5 px-5 text-xs"
          >
            Save Shipping Parameters
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
