"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Supplier } from "@/lib/types";
import { SEED_SUPPLIERS } from "@/data/seed-data";
import { ShieldCheck, AlertTriangle, ExternalLink, Plus, Check } from "lucide-react";

export default function AdminSuppliersPage() {
  const [suppliers, setSuppliers] = useState<Supplier[]>(SEED_SUPPLIERS);
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: "",
    contact_email: "",
    contact_phone: "",
    website_url: "",
    resale_permission_status: "verified_wholesale" as Supplier["resale_permission_status"],
    agreement_notes: "",
  });

  const handleAddSupplier = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const newSup: Supplier = {
      ...formData,
      id: `sup-${Date.now()}`,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    setSuppliers([...suppliers, newSup]);
    setModalOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-4">
        <div>
          <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-taupe font-sans block">
            Vendor Relationships
          </span>
          <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl text-charcoal">
            Authorized Suppliers &amp; Resale Rights ({suppliers.length})
          </h1>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setModalOpen(true)}
          className="btn-boutique-primary py-2.5 px-4 text-xs flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Add Supplier</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Compliance Notice */}
      <div className="bg-ivory/60 border border-champagne p-4 text-xs font-sans text-charcoal space-y-1">
        <p className="font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 text-charcoal">
          <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-taupe-dark" />
          Mandatory Commercial Resale Policy
        </p>
        <p className="text-charcoal/70 leading-relaxed font-light">
          Petal &amp; Pearl strictly sells products from suppliers where explicit commercial resale authorization has been signed. We never scrape or dropship without consent from unauthorized consumer retail sites.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Suppliers Table */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-sans">
            <thead className="bg-ivory/60 border-b border-[#EBE3D8] text-taupe-dark uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
              <tr>
                <th className="p-4">Supplier Studio</th>
                <th className="p-4">Contact</th>
                <th className="p-4">Resale Permission Status</th>
                <th className="p-4">Agreement Notes</th>
                <th className="p-4 text-right">Portal Link</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#EBE3D8]/60 text-charcoal">
              {suppliers.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={5} className="p-8 text-center text-taupe font-sans">
                    No suppliers added yet. Click &ldquo;+ Add Supplier&rdquo; to register your authorized wholesale partners.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                suppliers.map((sup) => (
                <tr key={sup.id} className="hover:bg-[#FAF8F5] transition-colors">
                  <td className="p-4 font-medium text-charcoal font-serif text-sm">
                    {sup.name}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-4 space-y-0.5">
                    <p>{sup.contact_email}</p>
                    <p className="text-taupe text-[10px]">{sup.contact_phone}</p>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-4">
                    {sup.resale_permission_status === "verified_wholesale" ? (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-medium">
                        <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> Verified Wholesale
                      </span>
                    ) : sup.resale_permission_status === "pending_agreement" ? (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-medium">
                        Pending Contract
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-medium">
                        Not Authorized
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-4 text-charcoal/70 text-[11px] max-w-xs font-light">
                    {sup.agreement_notes}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-4 text-right">
                    <a
                      href={sup.website_url}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-taupe hover:text-charcoal transition-colors underline"
                    >
                      <span>Website</span>
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </a>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Add Supplier Modal */}
      {modalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-charcoal/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-4 shadow-xl text-xs font-sans">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-serif text-xl text-charcoal">Add Verified Supplier</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)} className="text-taupe hover:text-charcoal uppercase">
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleAddSupplier} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Supplier / Studio Name *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={formData.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g. Jaipur Gems Guild"
                  className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-charcoal focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Contact Email *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    required
                    value={formData.contact_email}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, contact_email: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-charcoal focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Contact Phone
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={formData.contact_phone}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, contact_phone: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-charcoal focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Supplier Website URL
                </label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  value={formData.website_url}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, website_url: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="https://..."
                  className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-charcoal focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Resale Permission Status *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={formData.resale_permission_status}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, resale_permission_status: e.target.value as Supplier["resale_permission_status"] })}
                  className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-charcoal focus:outline-none"
                >
                  <option value="verified_wholesale">Verified Wholesale (Authorized)</option>
                  <option value="pending_agreement">Pending Agreement</option>
                  <option value="not_authorized">Not Authorized</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Agreement Details &amp; Terms
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={formData.agreement_notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, agreement_notes: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Notes on wholesale pricing agreement, MOQ, and packaging consent..."
                  className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-2.5 text-charcoal focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 flex justify-end gap-3">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)} className="btn-boutique-secondary py-2 px-4">
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button type="submit" className="btn-boutique-primary py-2 px-5">
                  Save Supplier
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

function isDirectImageUrl(urlStr: string): boolean {
  return (
    /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|avif|gif)(\?.*)?$/i.test(urlStr) ||
    urlStr.includes("images.unsplash.com") ||
    urlStr.includes("m.media-amazon.com/images") ||
    urlStr.includes("adn-static1.nykaa.com") ||
    urlStr.includes("assets.myntassets.com") ||
    urlStr.includes("mfrcdn.com") ||
    urlStr.includes("/media/catalog/product")
  );
}

function cleanTitleFromUrl(urlStr: string): string {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(urlStr);
    const pathname = parsed.pathname;
    const parts = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
    const lastPart = parts[parts.length - 1] || "Boutique Accessory";
    
    // Remove query params or trailing numbers/IDs
    const clean = lastPart
      .replace(/\.(html|htm|php|aspx|json)$/i, "")
      .replace(/^[0-9_-]+|[0-9_-]+$/g, "")
      .replace(/[-_]+/g, " ")
      .trim();

    return clean
      .split(" ")
      .map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase())
      .join(" ");
  } catch {
    return "New Boutique Accessory";
  }
}

function detectCategoryFromText(text: string): { category: string; subcategory: string } {
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  
  // Press-On Nails & Nail Art (Highest priority for nail links like Savana, Urbanic, Nykaa)
  if (
    lower.includes("nail") ||
    lower.includes("press-on") ||
    lower.includes("press on") ||
    lower.includes("artificial nail") ||
    lower.includes("false nail") ||
    lower.includes("fake nail") ||
    lower.includes("manicure")
  ) {
    if (lower.includes("sticker") || lower.includes("decal")) {
      return { category: "press-on-nails", subcategory: "nail-art-stickers" };
    }
    if (lower.includes("glue") || lower.includes("kit") || lower.includes("prep")) {
      return { category: "press-on-nails", subcategory: "nail-accessories" };
    }
    return { category: "press-on-nails", subcategory: "press-on-nails" };
  }

  // Sunglasses & Eyewear
  if (
    lower.includes("sunglass") ||
    lower.includes("shades") ||
    lower.includes("eyewear") ||
    lower.includes("goggles") ||
    lower.includes("spectacle")
  ) {
    if (lower.includes("chain") || lower.includes("cord") || lower.includes("strap")) {
      return { category: "eyewear", subcategory: "sunglass-chains" };
    }
    return { category: "eyewear", subcategory: "sunglasses" };
  }

  // Bags & Pouches
  if (
    lower.includes("vanity") ||
    lower.includes("makeup bag") ||
    lower.includes("cosmetic bag") ||
    lower.includes("clutch") ||
    lower.includes("tote") ||
    lower.includes("shoulder bag") ||
    lower.includes("handbag") ||
    lower.includes("purse") ||
    lower.includes("pouch")
  ) {
    if (lower.includes("tote")) {
      return { category: "bags-pouches", subcategory: "tote-bags" };
    }
    if (lower.includes("shoulder") || lower.includes("mini bag") || lower.includes("handbag") || lower.includes("purse")) {
      return { category: "bags-pouches", subcategory: "mini-bags" };
    }
    return { category: "bags-pouches", subcategory: "pouches" };
  }

  // Beauty & Vanity
  if (lower.includes("mirror") || lower.includes("compact")) {
    return { category: "beauty-vanity", subcategory: "compact-mirrors" };
  }
  if (lower.includes("brush") || lower.includes("comb")) {
    return { category: "beauty-vanity", subcategory: "hair-brushes" };
  }

  // Hair Accessories (Claw clips, hair pins, bows, scrunchies, headbands)
  if (
    lower.includes("headband") ||
    lower.includes("hairband") ||
    lower.includes("bandeau") ||
    lower.includes("alice band")
  ) {
    return { category: "hair-accessories", subcategory: "headbands" };
  }
  if (
    lower.includes("claw") ||
    lower.includes("hair clip") ||
    lower.includes("hairclip") ||
    lower.includes("jaw clip") ||
    lower.includes("banana clip") ||
    lower.includes("clip")
  ) {
    return { category: "hair-accessories", subcategory: "claw-clips" };
  }
  if (
    lower.includes("hair pin") ||
    lower.includes("hairpin") ||
    lower.includes("alligator clip") ||
    lower.includes("barrette") ||
    lower.includes("snap clip") ||
    lower.includes("bobby pin")
  ) {
    return { category: "hair-accessories", subcategory: "hair-pins-clips" };
  }
  if (
    lower.includes("scrunchie") ||
    lower.includes("scrunchy") ||
    lower.includes("hair tie") ||
    lower.includes("rubber band")
  ) {
    return { category: "hair-accessories", subcategory: "scrunchies" };
  }
  if (
    lower.includes("bow") ||
    lower.includes("ribbon")
  ) {
    return { category: "hair-accessories", subcategory: "hair-bows" };
  }

  // Jewellery
  if (lower.includes("anklet") || lower.includes("payal")) {
    return { category: "jewellery", subcategory: "anklets" };
  }
  if (lower.includes("earring") || lower.includes("stud") || lower.includes("hoop") || lower.includes("jhumk") || lower.includes("huggie") || lower.includes("drop earring")) {
    return { category: "jewellery", subcategory: "earrings" };
  }
  if (lower.includes("necklace") || lower.includes("choker") || lower.includes("chain") || lower.includes("pendant") || lower.includes("locket")) {
    return { category: "jewellery", subcategory: "necklaces" };
  }
  if (lower.includes("bracelet") || lower.includes("bangle") || lower.includes("cuff") || lower.includes("wristband")) {
    return { category: "jewellery", subcategory: "bracelets" };
  }
  if (lower.includes("ring") || lower.includes("band")) {
    return { category: "jewellery", subcategory: "rings" };
  }
  if (lower.includes("waist chain") || lower.includes("body chain") || lower.includes("belly chain")) {
    return { category: "jewellery", subcategory: "body-jewellery" };
  }

  // Everyday Essentials
  if (lower.includes("phone") || lower.includes("charm") || lower.includes("strap") || lower.includes("lanyard") || lower.includes("keychain")) {
    return { category: "everyday-essentials", subcategory: "phone-charms" };
  }
  if (lower.includes("trinket") || lower.includes("tray") || lower.includes("dish")) {
    return { category: "everyday-essentials", subcategory: "trinket-dishes" };
  }

  // Gifts & Keepsakes
  if (
    lower.includes("keepsake") ||
    lower.includes("jewelry box") ||
    lower.includes("jewellery box") ||
    lower.includes("makeup box") ||
    lower.includes("storage box") ||
    lower.includes("organizer box")
  ) {
    return { category: "gifts", subcategory: "keepsake-boxes" };
  }
  if (
    lower.includes("gift") ||
    lower.includes("hamper") ||
    lower.includes("set") ||
    lower.includes("combo") ||
    lower.includes("bundle")
  ) {
    return { category: "gifts", subcategory: "gift-sets" };
  }

  return { category: "hair-accessories", subcategory: "claw-clips" };
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { url, directImageUrl } = await req.json();

    if (!url || typeof url !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "A valid product link is required." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const trimmedUrl = url.trim();
    let parsedUrl: URL;
    try {
      parsedUrl = new URL(trimmedUrl);
    } catch {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Please enter a valid URL (e.g. https://...)." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    let title = "";
    let description = "";
    let imageUrl = typeof directImageUrl === "string" && directImageUrl.trim() ? directImageUrl.trim() : "";
    let isExtracted = false;

    // Check if the link itself is an image URL
    if (!imageUrl && isDirectImageUrl(trimmedUrl)) {
      imageUrl = trimmedUrl;
      title = cleanTitleFromUrl(trimmedUrl);
      isExtracted = true;
    }

    // Try HTML extraction if not already resolved as a direct image
    if (!imageUrl || !title) {
      try {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 7000);

        const response = await fetch(parsedUrl.toString(), {
          signal: controller.signal,
          headers: {
            "User-Agent":
              "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            Accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8",
            "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
            "Sec-Ch-Ua": "\"Chromium\";v=\"124\", \"Google Chrome\";v=\"124\", \"Not-A.Brand\";v=\"99\"",
            "Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile": "?0",
            "Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform": "\"Windows\"",
            "Sec-Fetch-Dest": "document",
            "Sec-Fetch-Mode": "navigate",
            "Sec-Fetch-Site": "none",
            "Upgrade-Insecure-Requests": "1",
          },
        });

        clearTimeout(timeoutId);

        if (response.ok) {
          const html = await response.text();

          // 1. Title Extraction (all meta and HTML tag orders)
          if (!title) {
            const ogTitle =
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*property=["']og:title["'][^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*property=["']og:title["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*name=["']twitter:title["'][^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*name=["']twitter:title["']/i)?.[1];

            if (ogTitle) {
              title = ogTitle.trim();
            } else {
              const titleTag = html.match(/<title[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/title>/i)?.[1];
              if (titleTag) {
                title = titleTag.split(/[|\-–—]/)[0].trim();
              }
            }
          }

          // 2. Image Extraction (OG, Twitter, JSON-LD, platform patterns)
          if (!imageUrl) {
            const extractedImg =
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*property=["']og:image["'][^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*property=["']og:image["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*name=["']twitter:image["'][^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*name=["']twitter:image["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*name=["']twitter:image:src["'][^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<link[^>]*rel=["']image_src["'][^>]*href=["']([^"']+)["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/https?:\/\/adn-static1\.nykaa\.com\/media\/catalog\/product\/[^\s"\x27]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)/i)?.[0] ||
              html.match(/https?:\/\/m\.media-amazon\.com\/images\/I\/[^\s"\x27]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)/i)?.[0] ||
              html.match(/https?:\/\/assets\.myntassets\.com\/[^\s"\x27]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)/i)?.[0];

            if (extractedImg) {
              imageUrl = extractedImg.trim();
              if (imageUrl.startsWith("//")) {
                imageUrl = "https:" + imageUrl;
              } else if (imageUrl.startsWith("/")) {
                imageUrl = parsedUrl.origin + imageUrl;
              }
            } else {
              // JSON-LD schema search
              const jsonLdMatch = html.match(/"image":\s*(\"[^\"]+\"|\[[^\]]+\])/i);
              if (jsonLdMatch && jsonLdMatch[1]) {
                const imgParsed = jsonLdMatch[1].match(/https?:\/\/[^"\x27]+/);
                if (imgParsed) {
                  imageUrl = imgParsed[0];
                }
              }
            }
          }

          // 3. Description Extraction
          if (!description) {
            const ogDesc =
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*property=["']og:description["'][^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*property=["']og:description["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*name=["']description["'][^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["']/i)?.[1] ||
              html.match(/<meta[^>]*content=["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*name=["']description["']/i)?.[1];

            if (ogDesc) {
              description = ogDesc.trim();
            }
          }

          if (title || imageUrl) {
            isExtracted = true;
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // Fallback gracefully if blocked or timed out
      }
    }

    // Determine category based on title, URL slug and text
    const { category, subcategory } = detectCategoryFromText((title || "") + " " + trimmedUrl);

    // Fallbacks if not extracted
    if (!title) {
      title = cleanTitleFromUrl(trimmedUrl);
    }

    if (!description) {
      description = "A thoughtfully curated " + subcategory.replace("-", " ") + " boutique piece for Petal & Pearl. Designed with organic contours and feminine details for effortless daily wear.";
    }

    if (!imageUrl) {
      // Pick matching studio category image so the product NEVER has a blank image
      imageUrl = CATEGORY_STUDIO_IMAGES[subcategory] || CATEGORY_STUDIO_IMAGES.earrings;
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      isExtracted,
      sourceUrl: trimmedUrl,
      data: {
        name: title,
        description,

      },
    });
  } catch (error) {

}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import crypto from "crypto";
import { getProductByIdAdmin, createOrder, updateOrderStatusAdmin } from "@/lib/store";
import { calculateShippingFee, DEFAULT_PRICING_SETTINGS, calculateContribution } from "@/lib/pricing-engine";
import { OrderItem, CustomerAddress } from "@/lib/types";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { customer, items } = body as {
      customer: CustomerAddress;
      items: Array<{ productId: string; variantId?: string; quantity: number }>;
    };

    if (!customer || !customer.name || !customer.email || !customer.phone || !customer.pincode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing required customer address fields." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (customer.country !== "India") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "International checkout is currently unavailable. We currently deliver within India only." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (!items || !Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Your shopping bag is empty." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Verify each item against server store
    const verifiedItems: OrderItem[] = [];
    let serverSubtotal = 0;
    let totalSupplierCost = 0;

    for (const item of items) {
      const product = getProductByIdAdmin(item.productId);
      if (!product || !product.is_visible) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: `A product in your bag is no longer available.` },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const variant = item.variantId ? product.variants.find((v) => v.id === item.variantId) : undefined;
      const unitSellingPrice = variant?.price_override ?? product.selling_price;
      const unitSupplierCost = product.supplier_cost;
      const qty = Math.max(1, Number(item.quantity) || 1);

      // Check stock
      const availableStock = variant ? variant.stock : product.stock;
      if (qty > availableStock) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: `Insufficient stock for ${product.name}. Available: ${availableStock}` },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const lineTotal = unitSellingPrice * qty;
      const lineCost = unitSupplierCost * qty;

      serverSubtotal += lineTotal;
      totalSupplierCost += lineCost;

      verifiedItems.push({
        id: `ord-item-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        product_id: product.id,
        variant_id: variant?.id,
        product_name: product.name,
        variant_title: variant?.title,
        sku: variant?.sku || product.sku,
        unit_selling_price: unitSellingPrice,
        unit_supplier_cost: unitSupplierCost,
        quantity: qty,
        total_price: lineTotal,
        total_cost: lineCost,
        image_url: product.images[0]?.image_url,
      });
    }

    const shippingFee = calculateShippingFee(serverSubtotal, DEFAULT_PRICING_SETTINGS);
    const totalPayable = serverSubtotal + shippingFee;

    // Calculate contribution metrics
    const contribution = calculateContribution({
      sellingPrice: serverSubtotal,
      supplierCost: totalSupplierCost,
      shippingCustomerPaid: shippingFee,
    });

    // Save pending order to store
    const order = createOrder({
      customer,
      items: verifiedItems,
      status: "pending_payment",
      payment_status: "unpaid",
      subtotal: serverSubtotal,
      shipping_fee: shippingFee,
      discount_amount: 0,
      total_payable: totalPayable,
      total_supplier_cost: totalSupplierCost,
      total_contribution: contribution.netContribution,
    });

    // Check if Razorpay keys are configured in environment
    const razorpayKeyId = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID;
    const razorpaySecret = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET;

    if (razorpayKeyId && razorpaySecret) {
      try {
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
        const Razorpay = require("razorpay");
        const instance = new Razorpay({
          key_id: razorpayKeyId,
          key_secret: razorpaySecret,
        });

        const rzpOrder = await instance.orders.create({
          amount: Math.round(totalPayable * 100), // amount in paise
          currency: "INR",
          receipt: order.order_number,
          notes: {
            orderNumber: order.order_number,
            customerEmail: customer.email,
          },
        });

        // Store Razorpay order ID on internal order
        updateOrderStatusAdmin({
          orderNumber: order.order_number,
          status: "pending_payment",
          razorpayOrderId: rzpOrder.id,
        });

        return NextResponse.json({
          orderNumber: order.order_number,
          razorpayOrderId: rzpOrder.id,
          amountPaise: rzpOrder.amount,
          currency: "INR",
          keyId: razorpayKeyId,
          isLivePayment: true,
        });
      } catch (rzpErr) {
        console.error("Razorpay order creation failed, falling back to staging simulation:", rzpErr);
      }
    }

    // Safe simulation mode when live credentials are not yet configured
    const simulatedOrderId = `order_sim_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString("hex")}`;
    return NextResponse.json({
      orderNumber: order.order_number,
      razorpayOrderId: simulatedOrderId,
      amountPaise: Math.round(totalPayable * 100),
      currency: "INR",
      keyId: "rzp_test_unconfigured",
      isLivePayment: false,
      message: "Gateway in demo/staging mode. Real credentials pending in .env.local.",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Create order error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to create order. Please try again." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import crypto from "crypto";
import { getOrderByNumber, updateOrderStatusAdmin } from "@/lib/store";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { orderNumber, razorpayOrderId, razorpayPaymentId, razorpaySignature } = await req.json();

    if (!orderNumber || !razorpayOrderId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing verification parameters." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const order = getOrderByNumber(orderNumber);
    if (!order) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Order not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const razorpaySecret = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET;

    // If live credentials are provided, strictly verify HMAC SHA-256 signature
    if (razorpaySecret) {
      if (!razorpayPaymentId || !razorpaySignature) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Missing required Razorpay payment ID or signature for verification." },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const generatedSignature = crypto
        .createHmac("sha256", razorpaySecret)
        .update(`${razorpayOrderId}|${razorpayPaymentId}`)
        .digest("hex");

      const isMatch =
        generatedSignature.length === razorpaySignature.length &&
        crypto.timingSafeEqual(
          Buffer.from(generatedSignature, "utf8"),
          Buffer.from(razorpaySignature, "utf8")
        );

      if (!isMatch) {
        console.error("Payment signature verification failed!");
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Payment verification failed. Security signature mismatch." },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
    }

    // Prevent duplicate processing if already verified
    if (order.status === "paid" || order.payment_status === "paid") {
      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        orderNumber,
        status: "paid",
        message: "Order already confirmed and payment processed.",
      });
    }

    // Update order status to Paid and persist Razorpay transaction references
    updateOrderStatusAdmin({
      orderNumber,
      status: "paid",
      paymentStatus: "paid",
      razorpayOrderId,
      razorpayPaymentId,
      razorpaySignature,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      orderNumber,
      status: "paid",
      message: "Payment successfully verified and order confirmed.",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Payment verification error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Server payment verification failed." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Razorpay from "razorpay";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { amount, currency = "INR", receipt } = body;

    // Validate amount
    const parsedAmount = Number(amount);
    if (!amount || isNaN(parsedAmount)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "A valid amount in paise is required." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Minimum amount: 100 paise (₹1.00)
    if (parsedAmount < 100) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Minimum order amount is 100 paise (₹1.00)." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const keyId = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID;
    const keySecret = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET;

    if (!keyId || !keySecret) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Razorpay credentials are not configured on the server." },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    const razorpay = new Razorpay({
      key_id: keyId,
      key_secret: keySecret,
    });

    const receiptId = receipt || `rcpt_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;

    try {
      const order = await razorpay.orders.create({
        amount: Math.round(parsedAmount),
        currency: currency.toUpperCase(),
        receipt: receiptId,
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        order_id: order.id,
        amount: order.amount,
        currency: order.currency,
        key_id: keyId,
      });
    } catch (rzpErr: unknown) {
      const errObj = rzpErr as { statusCode?: number; error?: { description?: string; code?: string }; message?: string };
      console.error("Razorpay API Error:", rzpErr);

      if (errObj.statusCode === 401 || errObj.error?.code === "BAD_REQUEST_ERROR" && errObj.message?.includes("auth")) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Razorpay authentication failed. Invalid Key ID or Secret." },
          { status: 401 }
        );
      }

      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: errObj.error?.description || errObj.message || "Failed to create order with Razorpay." },
        { status: errObj.statusCode || 500 }
      );
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Unexpected error in /api/create-order:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Invalid request payload." },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import crypto from "crypto";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    // Support both standard Razorpay naming and camelCase
    const orderId = body.razorpay_order_id || body.order_id || body.orderId;
    const paymentId = body.razorpay_payment_id || body.payment_id || body.paymentId;
    const signature = body.razorpay_signature || body.signature;

    // Validate required fields
    if (!orderId || !paymentId || !signature) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Missing required payment verification fields (order_id, payment_id, signature).",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const keySecret = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET;
    if (!keySecret) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Razorpay secret key is not configured on the server.",
        },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    // Algorithm: HMAC-SHA256(order_id + "|" + payment_id, KEY_SECRET)
    const expectedSignature = crypto
      .createHmac("sha256", keySecret)
      .update(`${orderId}|${paymentId}`)
      .digest("hex");

    const isMatch =
      expectedSignature.length === signature.length &&
      crypto.timingSafeEqual(
        Buffer.from(expectedSignature, "utf8"),
        Buffer.from(signature, "utf8")
      );

    if (!isMatch) {
      console.warn(`Payment signature mismatch for order ${orderId}`);
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: "Invalid payment signature. Verification failed.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      order_id: orderId,
      payment_id: paymentId,
      message: "Payment signature verified successfully.",
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("Error in /api/verify-payment:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Failed to process payment verification request.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import crypto from "crypto";
import { updateOrderStatusAdmin, getOrderByNumber, getAllOrdersAdmin } from "@/lib/store";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const rawBody = await req.text();
    const signature = req.headers.get("x-razorpay-signature");
    const webhookSecret = process.env.RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET;

    // Verify webhook signature if secret is configured
    if (webhookSecret) {
      if (!signature) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing webhook signature" }, { status: 400 });
      }

      const expectedSignature = crypto
        .createHmac("sha256", webhookSecret)
        .update(rawBody)
        .digest("hex");

      const isMatch =
        expectedSignature.length === signature.length &&
        crypto.timingSafeEqual(
          Buffer.from(expectedSignature, "utf8"),
          Buffer.from(signature, "utf8")
        );

      if (!isMatch) {
        console.error("Invalid Razorpay webhook signature");
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid signature" }, { status: 400 });
      }
    }

    const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody);
    const event = payload.event;
    const paymentEntity = payload.payload?.payment?.entity;
    const paymentId = paymentEntity?.id;
    const orderId = paymentEntity?.order_id;
    const method = paymentEntity?.method;

    if (event === "payment.captured" || event === "order.paid") {
      const orderReceipt = paymentEntity?.notes?.orderNumber;

      // Find order by order_number or by razorpay_order_id
      let targetOrder = orderReceipt ? getOrderByNumber(orderReceipt) : null;
      if (!targetOrder && orderId) {
        const allOrders = getAllOrdersAdmin();
        targetOrder = allOrders.find((o) => o.razorpay_order_id === orderId) || null;
      }

      if (targetOrder) {
        // Prevent duplicate webhook processing
        if (targetOrder.status === "paid" || targetOrder.payment_status === "paid") {
          return NextResponse.json({ status: "already_processed", orderNumber: targetOrder.order_number });
        }

        updateOrderStatusAdmin({
          orderNumber: targetOrder.order_number,
          status: "paid",
          paymentStatus: "paid",
          razorpayOrderId: orderId || targetOrder.razorpay_order_id,
          razorpayPaymentId: paymentId,
          paymentMethod: method,
        });

        console.log(`Webhook successfully confirmed payment for Order ${targetOrder.order_number}`);
      }
    } else if (event === "payment.failed") {
      const orderReceipt = paymentEntity?.notes?.orderNumber;
      if (orderReceipt) {
        const targetOrder = getOrderByNumber(orderReceipt);
        if (targetOrder && targetOrder.status === "pending_payment") {
          updateOrderStatusAdmin({
            orderNumber: targetOrder.order_number,
            status: "pending_payment",
            paymentStatus: "failed",
            razorpayPaymentId: paymentId,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok" });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Webhook processing error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Webhook handler failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useCart } from "@/context/cart-context";
import { Trash2, Plus, Minus, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck, Truck, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";

export default function CartPage() {
  const {
    items,
    removeItem,
    updateQuantity,
    subtotal,
    shippingFee,
    amountNeededForFreeShipping,
    freeShippingThreshold,
    totalPayable,
  } = useCart();

  const [promoCode, setPromoCode] = useState("");
  const [promoApplied, setPromoApplied] = useState(false);
  const [promoError, setPromoError] = useState("");

  const handleApplyPromo = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (promoCode.trim().toUpperCase() === "WELCOME10") {
      setPromoApplied(true);
      setPromoError("");
    } else {
      setPromoError("Invalid code. Use WELCOME10 for 10% off your first order.");
    }
  };

  const discountAmount = promoApplied ? Math.round(subtotal * 0.1) : 0;
  const finalPayable = Math.max(0, totalPayable - discountAmount);

  if (items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-24 text-center space-y-6">
        <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-ivory flex items-center justify-center mx-auto border border-champagne">
          <Sparkles className="w-8 h-8 text-taupe-dark" />
        </div>
        <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-charcoal">
          Your Shopping Bag is Empty
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-charcoal/70 font-sans max-w-md mx-auto font-light">
          Your keepsake collection awaits. Explore our delicate pearls, silk bows, and everyday boutique treasures.
        </p>
        <div className="pt-2">
          <Link href="/shop" className="btn-boutique-primary">
            Explore The Collection
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12 sm:py-16 space-y-10">
      
      {/* Page Title */}
      <div className="border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-6">
        <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-taupe font-sans block mb-1">
          Review Your Selection
        </span>
        <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-charcoal">
          Shopping Bag ({items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.quantity, 0)})
        </h1>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 items-start">
        
        {/* Left Column: Cart Items List */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 space-y-6">
          
          {/* Free Shipping Alert Bar */}
          <div className="bg-ivory/60 border border-champagne/60 p-4">
            {amountNeededForFreeShipping > 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-charcoal/80 font-sans">
                Add <span className="font-semibold text-charcoal">₹{amountNeededForFreeShipping}</span> more to unlock <span className="font-semibold text-charcoal">FREE Express Shipping</span> across India.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-xs text-emerald-800 font-sans font-medium">
                ✨ Complimentary Boutique Express Shipping Unlocked!
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="w-full bg-[#E3D9CC] h-1.5 rounded-full mt-2 overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="bg-taupe h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.round((subtotal / freeShippingThreshold) * 100))}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Items Table */}
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {items.map((item) => {
              const img = item.product.images[0]?.image_url || "";
              const unitPrice = item.variant?.price_override ?? item.product.selling_price;
              const lineTotal = unitPrice * item.quantity;

              return (
                <div
                  key={`${item.product.id}-${item.variant?.id || "default"}`}
                  className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-6 p-5 bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] hover:border-champagne transition-all"
                >
                  <div className="flex gap-4 items-center">
                    <div className="relative w-20 h-24 bg-ivory shrink-0 border border-[#EBE3D8] overflow-hidden">
                      {img && (
                        <Image
                          src={img}
                          alt={item.product.name}
                          fill
                          className="object-cover object-center"
                        />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-taupe font-sans block">
                        {item.product.category.replace("-", " ")}
                      </span>
                      <Link
                        href={`/product/${item.product.slug}`}
                        className="font-serif text-lg text-charcoal hover:text-taupe transition-colors leading-snug line-clamp-1"
                      >
                        {item.product.name}
                      </Link>
                      {item.variant && (
                        <span className="text-xs text-taupe block font-sans">
                          Option: {item.variant.title}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-charcoal font-sans block sm:hidden">
                        ₹{unitPrice}

                  </div>

            {promoApplied && (

          {/* Proceed Button */}

"use client";

import { use, useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import ProductCard from "@/components/ProductCard";
import { getPublicProducts } from "@/lib/public-catalog";
import { CATEGORIES_DATA } from "@/data/seed-data";
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowUpDown } from "lucide-react";

export default function CategoryPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = use(params);

  const matched = CATEGORIES_DATA.find((c) => c.slug === slug);
  const categoryMeta = matched || {
    id: slug,
    name: slug.replace(/-/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (l) => l.toUpperCase()),
    slug: slug,
    description: `Curated collection of boutique ${slug.replace(/-/g, " ")}.`,
    image_url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535632066927-ab7c9ab60908?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80",
    subcategories: [],
  };

  const [allProducts, setAllProducts] = useState(() => getPublicProducts({ category: slug }));

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(`/api/products?category=${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
        if (data?.products && Array.isArray(data.products) && data.products.length > 0) {
          setAllProducts(data.products);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [slug]);

  const [selectedSub, setSelectedSub] = useState<string>("all");
  const [onlyHottest, setOnlyHottest] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<string>("relevance");

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let result = [...allProducts];
    if (onlyHottest) {
      result = result.filter((p) => p.is_bestseller);
    }
    if (selectedSub !== "all") {
      result = result.filter((p) => p.subcategory === selectedSub);
    }
    switch (sortBy) {
      case "price-asc":
        result.sort((a, b) => a.selling_price - b.selling_price);
        break;
      case "price-desc":
        result.sort((a, b) => b.selling_price - a.selling_price);
        break;
      case "hottest":
        result.sort((a, b) => (b.is_bestseller ? 1 : 0) - (a.is_bestseller ? 1 : 0));
        break;
      case "newest":
        result.sort((a, b) => (b.is_new ? 1 : 0) - (a.is_new ? 1 : 0));
        break;
      case "alpha":
        result.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
        break;
      case "relevance":
      default:
        result.sort((a, b) => {
          const scoreB = (b.is_bestseller ? 4 : 0) + (b.is_featured ? 2 : 0) + (b.is_new ? 1 : 0);
          const scoreA = (a.is_bestseller ? 4 : 0) + (a.is_featured ? 2 : 0) + (a.is_new ? 1 : 0);
          return scoreB - scoreA;
        });
        break;
    }
    return result;
  }, [allProducts, selectedSub, onlyHottest, sortBy]);

  const hottestCount = allProducts.filter((p) => p.is_bestseller).length;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12 sm:py-16 space-y-10">
      
      {/* Breadcrumb Navigation */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-sans text-taupe">
        <Link href="/" className="hover:text-charcoal transition-colors">Home</Link>
        <span>/</span>
        <Link href="/shop" className="hover:text-charcoal transition-colors">Collections</Link>
        <span>/</span>
        <span className="text-charcoal font-medium">{categoryMeta.name}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Editorial Category Header */}
      <div className="text-center max-w-2xl mx-auto space-y-4">
        <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-taupe font-sans block">
          Boutique Department
        </span>
        <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl sm:text-5xl text-charcoal">
          {categoryMeta.name}
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-charcoal/70 font-sans font-light leading-relaxed">
          {categoryMeta.description}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Subcategory Pills & Controls */}
      <div className="border-y border-[#EBE3D8] py-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
        
        {/* Subcategories */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSelectedSub("all");
              setOnlyHottest(false);
            }}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-sans transition-all ${
              selectedSub === "all" && !onlyHottest
                ? "bg-charcoal text-white font-medium"
                : "bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] text-charcoal/70 hover:border-champagne hover:text-charcoal"
            }`}
          >
            All {categoryMeta.name} ({allProducts.length})
          </button>

          {hottestCount > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setOnlyHottest(!onlyHottest)}
              className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-sans transition-all flex items-center gap-1 ${
                onlyHottest
                  ? "bg-[#2D2A26] text-[#FAF8F5] font-medium shadow-sm"
                  : "bg-[#FAF7F2] border border-champagne text-[#C2714F] hover:border-charcoal font-medium"
              }`}
            >
              <span>🔥 Hottest Picks</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] opacity-80">({hottestCount})</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {categoryMeta.subcategories.map((sub) => {
            const count = allProducts.filter((p) => p.subcategory === sub.id).length;
            const isSelected = selectedSub === sub.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={sub.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedSub(sub.id);
                  setOnlyHottest(false);
                }}
                className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-sans transition-all flex items-center gap-1 ${
                  isSelected
                    ? "bg-charcoal text-white font-medium"
                    : "bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] text-charcoal/70 hover:border-champagne hover:text-charcoal"
                }`}
              >
                <span>{sub.name}</span>
                {count > 0 && (
                  <span className={`text-[10px] ${isSelected ? "opacity-80" : "text-taupe"}`}>
                    ({count})
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Sort */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-sans text-charcoal/80">
          <ArrowUpDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-taupe" />
          <select
            value={sortBy}
            onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-transparent text-charcoal text-xs uppercase tracking-wider focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="relevance">Relevance &bull; Curated</option>
            <option value="price-asc">Price: Low to High (₹)</option>
            <option value="price-desc">Price: High to Low (₹)</option>
            <option value="hottest">🔥 Hottest Picks First</option>
            <option value="newest">New Arrivals</option>
            <option value="alpha">Alphabetical (A - Z)</option>
          </select>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Product Grid */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-20 bg-ivory/60 border border-champagne p-8 sm:p-12 space-y-4 max-w-xl mx-auto">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-white border border-champagne text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-charcoal font-sans">
            ✦ DROP 01 IN PREPARATION
          </div>
          <h3 className="font-serif text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-charcoal">
            {categoryMeta.name} Pieces Dropping Soon
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-charcoal/70 font-sans leading-relaxed max-w-md mx-auto">
            Our atelier is stocking this collection with hand-selected pieces. Explore our other vibes or check back during the next drop.
          </p>
          <div className="pt-2">
            <Link href="/shop" className="btn-boutique-primary">
              View All Boutique Vibes
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5 sm:gap-6">
          {filtered.map((product) => (
            <ProductCard key={product.id} product={product} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Back to shop */}
      <div className="pt-8 text-center">
        <Link href="/shop" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-sans text-charcoal hover:text-taupe transition-colors">
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Explore All Categories</span>
        </Link>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useCart } from "@/context/cart-context";
import { Lock, ShieldCheck, AlertCircle, ArrowLeft, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";

const INDIAN_STATES = [
  "Andhra Pradesh",
  "Arunachal Pradesh",
  "Assam",
  "Bihar",
  "Chhattisgarh",
  "Goa",
  "Gujarat",
  "Haryana",
  "Himachal Pradesh",
  "Jharkhand",
  "Karnataka",
  "Kerala",
  "Madhya Pradesh",
  "Maharashtra",
  "Manipur",
  "Meghalaya",
  "Mizoram",
  "Nagaland",
  "Odisha",
  "Punjab",
  "Rajasthan",
  "Sikkim",
  "Tamil Nadu",
  "Telangana",
  "Tripura",
  "Uttar Pradesh",
  "Uttarakhand",
  "West Bengal",
  "Delhi",
  "Chandigarh",
  "Jammu & Kashmir",
  "Ladakh",
  "Puducherry",
];

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { items, subtotal, shippingFee, totalPayable, clearCart } = useCart();

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: "",
    email: "",
    phone: "",
    house: "",
    street: "",
    city: "",
    state: "Karnataka",
    pincode: "",
  });

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");
  const [demoNotice, setDemoNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto px-4 py-24 text-center space-y-4">
        <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl text-charcoal">Your bag is empty</h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-charcoal/70 font-sans">
          Please add items to your shopping bag before proceeding to checkout.
        </p>
        <Link href="/shop" className="btn-boutique-primary inline-block">
          Return to Shop
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  };

  const handleCheckoutSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage("");
    setDemoNotice(null);

    // Validate Indian PIN code (6 digits)
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(formData.pincode.trim())) {
      setErrorMessage("Please enter a valid 6-digit Indian PIN code.");
      return;
    }

    // Validate phone number (10 digits)
    const cleanPhone = formData.phone.replace(/\D/g, "");
    if (cleanPhone.length < 10) {
      setErrorMessage("Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.");
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      // 1. Create order on server
      const payload = {
        customer: {
          ...formData,
          phone: `+91 ${cleanPhone.slice(-10)}`,
          country: "India" as const,
        },
        items: items.map((i) => ({
          productId: i.product.id,
          variantId: i.variant?.id,
          quantity: i.quantity,
        })),
      };

      const res = await fetch("/api/checkout/create-order", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const orderData = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(orderData.error || "Failed to initialize checkout.");
      }

      const { orderNumber, razorpayOrderId, isLivePayment } = orderData;

      // 2. Check if Live Razorpay is active
      if (isLivePayment && typeof window !== "undefined") {
        // Load Razorpay Standard Modal script dynamically if not present
        if (!(window as unknown as { Razorpay?: unknown }).Razorpay) {
          await new Promise((resolve) => {
            const script = document.createElement("script");
            script.src = "https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js";
            script.onload = resolve;
            document.body.appendChild(script);
          });
        }

        interface RzpResponse {
          razorpay_order_id: string;
          razorpay_payment_id: string;
          razorpay_signature: string;
        }

        const options = {
          key: orderData.keyId,
          amount: orderData.amountPaise,
          currency: "INR",
          name: "Petal & Pearl",
          description: `Order ${orderNumber} - Prepaid Boutique Adornments`,
          order_id: razorpayOrderId,
          prefill: {
            name: formData.name,
            email: formData.email,
            contact: cleanPhone,
          },
          theme: {
            color: "#39342F",
          },
          handler: async function (response: RzpResponse) {
            // Server verification
            const verifyRes = await fetch("/api/checkout/verify-payment", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                orderNumber,
                razorpayOrderId: response.razorpay_order_id,
                razorpayPaymentId: response.razorpay_payment_id,
                razorpaySignature: response.razorpay_signature,
              }),
            });

            const verifyData = await verifyRes.json();
            if (verifyRes.ok && verifyData.success) {
              clearCart();
              router.push(`/order-confirmation/${orderNumber}`);
            } else {
              setErrorMessage("Payment verification failed. Please contact boutique support.");
              setIsLoading(false);
            }
          },
          modal: {
            ondismiss: function () {
              setIsLoading(false);
              setErrorMessage("Payment was cancelled. You can retry checkout anytime.");
            },
          },
        };

        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
        const rzp = new (window as any).Razorpay(options);
        
        // Handle payment failure event
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
        rzp.on("payment.failed", function (response: any) {
          console.error("Razorpay payment failed:", response.error);
          const reason =
            response.error?.description ||
            response.error?.reason ||
            "Payment transaction failed. Please retry with UPI, NetBanking, or card.";
          setErrorMessage(`Payment failed: ${reason}`);
          setIsLoading(false);
        });

        rzp.open();
        return;
      }

      // 3. Staging / Test fallback mode with clear UI indicator
      setDemoNotice("Live payment gateway keys not configured in .env.local. Simulating authorized test verification...");
      
      const verifyRes = await fetch("/api/checkout/verify-payment", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          orderNumber,
          razorpayOrderId,
          razorpayPaymentId: `pay_sim_${Date.now()}`,
          razorpaySignature: "simulated_valid_test_signature",
        }),
      });

      const verifyData = await verifyRes.json();
      if (verifyRes.ok && verifyData.success) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          clearCart();
          router.push(`/order-confirmation/${orderNumber}`);
        }, 1500);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Simulation verification failed.");
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Something went wrong during checkout.";
      setErrorMessage(msg);
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10 sm:py-16 space-y-10">
      
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-5">
        <div>
          <Link
            href="/cart"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-sans text-taupe hover:text-charcoal mb-1"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Back to Bag
          </Link>
          <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl text-charcoal">Prepaid Checkout</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-sans text-taupe bg-ivory px-3 py-1.5 border border-champagne">
          <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-taupe-dark" />
          <span>256-bit Encrypted</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mandatory Prepaid Notice */}
      <div className="bg-ivory/80 border border-champagne p-4 text-xs font-sans text-charcoal/90 space-y-1">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium text-charcoal">
          <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-taupe-dark shrink-0" />
          <span>Prepaid Orders Only &bull; Cash on Delivery (COD) Unavailable</span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-charcoal/70 pl-6 leading-relaxed">
          To maintain handcrafted boutique standards and preserve the pristine condition of delicate baroque pearls and ribbons, we only accept prepaid orders (UPI, NetBanking, Cards). Every parcel is sealed in a tamper-evident boutique box.
        </p>
      </div>

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 p-4 text-xs font-sans text-rose-800 flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{errorMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {demoNotice && (
        <div className="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 p-4 text-xs font-sans text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-amber-700" />
          <span>{demoNotice}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleCheckoutSubmit} className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-10 items-start">
        
        {/* Shipping Form (8 cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6">
          <h2 className="font-serif text-xl text-charcoal border-b border-[#EBE3D8] pb-3">
            1. Shipping &amp; Contact Details
          </h2>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs font-sans">
            <div className="sm:col-span-2 space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                Full Name *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                name="name"
                required
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleInputChange}
                placeholder="e.g. Radhika Sen"
                className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-3 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                Email Address *
              </label>
              <input
                type="email"
                name="email"
                required
                value={formData.email}
                onChange={handleInputChange}
                placeholder="For tracking & receipt"
                className="w-full bg-ivory/30 border border-champagne p-3 text-xs text-charcoal focus:outline-none focus:border-charcoal"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-charcoal font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                Mobile Number (+91) *
              </label>
              <input
                type="tel"
                name="phone"
                required
                value={formData.phone}
                onChange={handleInputChange}

          { label: "Returns & Replacements", value: "returns" },
          { label: "Gifting", value: "gifting" },
        ].map((tab) => (
          <button
            key={tab.value}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory(tab.value)}
            className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-sans transition-all ${
              activeCategory === tab.value
                ? "bg-charcoal text-white font-medium"
                : "bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] text-charcoal/70 hover:border-champagne hover:text-charcoal"
            }`}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Accordion FAQ list */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {filteredFaqs.map((faq, idx) => {
          const isOpen = openIndices.includes(idx);
          return (
            <div
              key={faq.question}
              className="bg-white border border-[#EBE3D8] transition-all hover:border-champagne"
            >
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleIndex(idx)}
                className="w-full p-5 text-left flex items-center justify-between gap-4 focus:outline-none"
              >
                <h3 className="font-serif text-lg sm:text-xl text-charcoal leading-snug">
                  {faq.question}
                </h3>
                <ChevronDown
                  className={`w-4 h-4 text-taupe shrink-0 transition-transform duration-300 ${
                    isOpen ? "rotate-180 text-charcoal" : ""
                  }`}
                />
              </button>

              {isOpen && (
                <div className="px-5 pb-5 pt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-charcoal/80 font-sans font-light leading-relaxed border-t border-[#EBE3D8]/50">
                  <p>{faq.answer}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Help Banner */}
      <div className="bg-ivory/60 border border-champagne p-8 text-center space-y-3">
        <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-taupe mx-auto" />
        <h3 className="font-serif text-xl text-charcoal">Have an unanswered question?</h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-charcoal/70 font-sans max-w-sm mx-auto font-light">
          Our boutique concierge team is always delighted to assist you directly.

          <Link href="/contact" className="btn-boutique-primary">
            Contact Concierge
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

  const [submittingVip, setSubmittingVip] = useState(false);
  const [vipMessage, setVipMessage] = useState("");
  const [vipSuccess, setVipSuccess] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/products")
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
        if (data?.products && Array.isArray(data.products)) {
          setAllProducts(data.products);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoadingProducts(false));
  }, []);

  const handleVipSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!vipEmail || !vipEmail.includes("@")) return;

    setVipMessage("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/newsletter", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: vipEmail }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        setVipSuccess(true);
        setVipMessage(data.message || "You are on the VIP Close Friends list! Welcome code WELCOME10 is saved.");
        setVipEmail("");

        setVipMessage(data.error || "Could not register email. Please try again.");
