// ==============================================================================
// PETAL & PEARL — PRICING & CONTRIBUTION ENGINE
// Domain: https://thepearlpetals.in
// Rule: Selling Price = Supplier Cost + Markup (Default ₹50)
// ==============================================================================

export interface PricingSettings {
  defaultMarkup: number; // default ₹50
  freeShippingThreshold: number; // default ₹999
  flatShippingFee: number; // default ₹99
  paymentGatewayFeePercent: number; // default 2% for Razorpay
  paymentGatewayGstPercent: number; // default 18% on gateway fee
}

export const DEFAULT_PRICING_SETTINGS: PricingSettings = {
  defaultMarkup: 50,
  freeShippingThreshold: 999,
  flatShippingFee: 99,
  paymentGatewayFeePercent: 0.02, // 2%
  paymentGatewayGstPercent: 0.18, // 18%
};

/**
 * Calculates the consumer-facing selling price from the supplier cost.
 * Selling price = supplierCost + markup
 *
 * @param supplierCost The verified unit cost charged by the authorized supplier
 * @param customMarkup Optional specific markup; defaults to DEFAULT_PRICING_SETTINGS.defaultMarkup (₹50)
 * @returns sellingPrice (number)
 */
export function calculateSellingPrice(supplierCost: number, customMarkup?: number | null): number {
  const markup = customMarkup !== undefined && customMarkup !== null ? customMarkup : DEFAULT_PRICING_SETTINGS.defaultMarkup;
  const cost = Math.max(0, Number(supplierCost) || 0);
  return Math.round(cost + markup);
}

/**
 * Calculates shipping fee based on subtotal.
 * Orders >= freeShippingThreshold (₹999) receive FREE shipping.
 * Otherwise, flat shipping fee (₹99) applies.
 */
export function calculateShippingFee(subtotal: number, settings: PricingSettings = DEFAULT_PRICING_SETTINGS): number {
  if (subtotal <= 0) return 0;
  return subtotal >= settings.freeShippingThreshold ? 0 : settings.flatShippingFee;
}

/**
 * Strips confidential supplier cost and internal margins before sending product data to client.
 */
export function sanitizePublicProduct<T extends { supplier_cost?: number; custom_markup?: number | null }>(product: T): Omit<T, "supplier_cost" | "custom_markup"> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars
  const { supplier_cost, custom_markup, ...publicData } = product;
  return publicData;
}

export interface ContributionBreakdown {
  sellingPrice: number;
  supplierCost: number;
  grossMargin: number;
  shippingCustomerPaid: number;
  shippingActualCost: number;
  paymentGatewayFee: number;
  packagingCost: number;
  netContribution: number;
  contributionMarginPercent: number;
}

/**
 * Computes actual contribution after all fulfillment and operational deductions.
 * Formula: Net Contribution = Selling Price + Shipping Paid - Supplier Cost - Actual Shipping - Gateway Fee - Packaging
 */
export function calculateContribution(params: {
  sellingPrice: number;
  supplierCost: number;
  shippingCustomerPaid: number;
  shippingActualCost?: number;
  packagingCost?: number;
  gatewayFeePercent?: number;
}): ContributionBreakdown {
  const {
    sellingPrice,
    supplierCost,
    shippingCustomerPaid,
    shippingActualCost = 65, // Standard Delhivery/BlueDart e-commerce rate ~₹65
    packagingCost = 25, // Luxury branded box + butter paper + ribbon ~₹25
    gatewayFeePercent = 0.0236, // 2% Razorpay + 18% GST = 2.36%
  } = params;

  const totalCollected = sellingPrice + shippingCustomerPaid;
  const paymentGatewayFee = Math.round(totalCollected * gatewayFeePercent * 100) / 100;
  const grossMargin = sellingPrice - supplierCost;
  
  const totalExpenses = supplierCost + shippingActualCost + paymentGatewayFee + packagingCost;
  const netContribution = Math.round((totalCollected - totalExpenses) * 100) / 100;
  const contributionMarginPercent = totalCollected > 0 
    ? Math.round((netContribution / totalCollected) * 10000) / 100 
    : 0;

  return {
    sellingPrice,
    supplierCost,
    grossMargin,
    shippingCustomerPaid,
    shippingActualCost,
    paymentGatewayFee,
    packagingCost,
    netContribution,
    contributionMarginPercent,
  };
}

// ==============================================================================

import { PublicProduct } from "./types";
import { SEED_PRODUCTS, CATEGORIES_DATA } from "../data/seed-data";
import { sanitizePublicProduct } from "./pricing-engine";

export { CATEGORIES_DATA };

// Base public catalogue (Supplier costs strictly sanitized)
const PUBLIC_CATALOGUE: PublicProduct[] = SEED_PRODUCTS.filter((p) => p.is_visible).map(
  sanitizePublicProduct
);

export function getPublicProducts(filters?: {
  category?: string;
  subcategory?: string;
  featured?: boolean;
  bestseller?: boolean;
  search?: string;
}): PublicProduct[] {
  let list = [...PUBLIC_CATALOGUE];

  if (filters?.category) {
    list = list.filter((p) => p.category === filters.category);
  }
  if (filters?.subcategory) {
    list = list.filter((p) => p.subcategory === filters.subcategory);
  }
  if (filters?.featured) {
    list = list.filter((p) => p.is_featured);
  }
  if (filters?.bestseller) {
    list = list.filter((p) => p.is_bestseller);
  }
  if (filters?.search) {
    const q = filters.search.toLowerCase().trim();
    list = list.filter(
      (p) =>
        p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }

  return list;
}

export function getPublicProductBySlug(slug: string): PublicProduct | null {
  const p = PUBLIC_CATALOGUE.find((item) => item.slug === slug);
  return p || null;
}

export function getPublicProductById(id: string): PublicProduct | null {
  const p = PUBLIC_CATALOGUE.find((item) => item.id === id);
  return p || null;
}

// ==============================================================================
// PETAL & PEARL — CENTRAL DATA STORE & REPOSITORY
// Domain: https://thepearlpetals.in
// Handles dynamic CRUD, public sanitization, order tracking & admin metrics
// ==============================================================================

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { Product, PublicProduct, Order, Supplier, OrderStatus } from "./types";
import { SEED_PRODUCTS, SEED_SUPPLIERS } from "../data/seed-data";
import { calculateSellingPrice, sanitizePublicProduct, DEFAULT_PRICING_SETTINGS, PricingSettings } from "./pricing-engine";

const DATA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "data");
const PRODUCTS_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "products.json");
const ORDERS_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "orders.json");
const SUPPLIERS_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "suppliers.json");
const SETTINGS_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "settings.json");
const SUBSCRIBERS_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "subscribers.json");

function ensureDirectoryExists() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
    try {
      fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
    } catch {
      // fallback in restricted env
    }
  }
}

// In-memory cache with fallback to disk persistence
let memoryProducts: Product[] = [...SEED_PRODUCTS];
let memorySuppliers: Supplier[] = [...SEED_SUPPLIERS];
let memoryOrders: Order[] = [];
let memorySettings: PricingSettings = { ...DEFAULT_PRICING_SETTINGS };
let memorySubscribers: Array<{ email: string; created_at: string; code: string }> = [];


// Helper to save to disk safely
function saveToFile(filePath: string, data: unknown) {
  try {
    ensureDirectoryExists();
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), "utf8");
  } catch {
    // If running in readonly context, memory state suffices
  }
}

// Initialize from file if exists
function loadInitialState() {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(PRODUCTS_FILE)) {
      memoryProducts = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(PRODUCTS_FILE, "utf8"));
    }
    if (fs.existsSync(ORDERS_FILE)) {
      memoryOrders = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(ORDERS_FILE, "utf8"));
    }
    if (fs.existsSync(SUPPLIERS_FILE)) {
      memorySuppliers = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(SUPPLIERS_FILE, "utf8"));
    }
    if (fs.existsSync(SETTINGS_FILE)) {
      memorySettings = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(SETTINGS_FILE, "utf8"));
    }
    if (fs.existsSync(SUBSCRIBERS_FILE)) {
      memorySubscribers = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(SUBSCRIBERS_FILE, "utf8"));
    }
  } catch {
    // continue with memory defaults
  }
}

loadInitialState();

// ==============================================================================
// PUBLIC FACING DATA ACCESS (SUPPLIER COSTS STRIPPED)
// ==============================================================================

export function getPublicProducts(filters?: {
  category?: string;
  subcategory?: string;
  featured?: boolean;
  bestseller?: boolean;
  search?: string;
}): PublicProduct[] {
  let list = memoryProducts.filter((p) => p.is_visible);

  if (filters?.category) {
    list = list.filter((p) => p.category === filters.category);
  }
  if (filters?.subcategory) {
    list = list.filter((p) => p.subcategory === filters.subcategory);
  }
  if (filters?.featured) {
    list = list.filter((p) => p.is_featured);
  }
  if (filters?.bestseller) {
    list = list.filter((p) => p.is_bestseller);
  }
  if (filters?.search) {
    const q = filters.search.toLowerCase();
    list = list.filter(
      (p) =>
        p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }

  return list.map(sanitizePublicProduct);
}

export function getPublicProductBySlug(slug: string): PublicProduct | null {
  const p = memoryProducts.find((item) => item.slug === slug && item.is_visible);
  if (!p) return null;
  return sanitizePublicProduct(p);
}

export function getPublicProductById(id: string): PublicProduct | null {
  const p = memoryProducts.find((item) => item.id === id && item.is_visible);
  if (!p) return null;
  return sanitizePublicProduct(p);
}

// ==============================================================================
// ORDER & TRACKING REPOSITORY
// ==============================================================================

export function createOrder(orderData: Omit<Order, "id" | "order_number" | "created_at" | "updated_at">): Order {
  const count = memoryOrders.length + 1001;
  const orderNumber = `PP-2026-${count}`;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const newOrder: Order = {
    ...orderData,
    id: `ord-${Date.now()}`,
    order_number: orderNumber,
    created_at: now,
    updated_at: now,
  };

  memoryOrders.unshift(newOrder);
  saveToFile(ORDERS_FILE, memoryOrders);
  return newOrder;
}

export function getOrderByNumber(orderNumber: string): Order | null {
  return memoryOrders.find((o) => o.order_number.toUpperCase() === orderNumber.trim().toUpperCase()) || null;
}

export function trackOrder(orderNumber: string, emailOrPhone: string): Order | null {
  const cleanNum = orderNumber.trim().toUpperCase();
  const cleanContact = emailOrPhone.trim().toLowerCase();

  const order = memoryOrders.find(
    (o) =>
      o.order_number.toUpperCase() === cleanNum &&
      (o.customer.email.toLowerCase() === cleanContact ||
        o.customer.phone.replace(/\s+/g, "").includes(cleanContact.replace(/\s+/g, "")))
  );

  return order || null;
}

// ==============================================================================
// ADMIN STORE REPOSITORY (FULL ACCESS)
// ==============================================================================

export function getAllProductsAdmin(): Product[] {
  return memoryProducts;
}

export function getProductByIdAdmin(id: string): Product | null {
  return memoryProducts.find((p) => p.id === id) || null;
}

export function saveProductAdmin(productData: Partial<Product> & { name: string; category: Product["category"]; subcategory: Product["subcategory"]; supplier_cost: number }): Product {
  const isUpdate = Boolean(productData.id);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const markup = productData.custom_markup !== undefined ? productData.custom_markup : memorySettings.defaultMarkup;
  const sellingPrice = calculateSellingPrice(productData.supplier_cost, markup);

  if (isUpdate && productData.id) {
    const idx = memoryProducts.findIndex((p) => p.id === productData.id);
    if (idx !== -1) {
      memoryProducts[idx] = {
        ...memoryProducts[idx],
        ...productData,
        selling_price: sellingPrice,
        updated_at: now,
      };
      saveToFile(PRODUCTS_FILE, memoryProducts);
      return memoryProducts[idx];
    }
  }

  // Create new
  const id = `prod-${Date.now()}`;
  const slug = productData.slug || productData.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/(^-|-$)/g, "");
  const sku = productData.sku || `PP-${productData.category.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;

  const newProduct: Product = {
    id,
    sku,
    name: productData.name,
    slug,
    category: productData.category,
    subcategory: productData.subcategory,
    description: productData.description || "",
    supplier_cost: Number(productData.supplier_cost),
    selling_price: sellingPrice,
    custom_markup: productData.custom_markup,
    stock: productData.stock || 0,
    is_featured: productData.is_featured || false,
    is_bestseller: productData.is_bestseller || false,
    is_new: productData.is_new !== undefined ? productData.is_new : true,
    is_visible: productData.is_visible !== undefined ? productData.is_visible : true,
    tags: productData.tags || [],
    product_link: productData.product_link || productData.source_url,
    source_url: productData.source_url || productData.product_link,
    images: productData.images || [
      {
        id: `img-${Date.now()}`,
        image_url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535632066927-ab7c9ab60908?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80",
        alt_text: productData.name,
        display_order: 1,
        is_primary: true,
      },
    ],
    variants: productData.variants || [
      { id: `var-${Date.now()}`, title: "Default Style", sku: `${sku}-DEF`, stock: productData.stock || 0, attributes: {} },
    ],
    created_at: now,
    updated_at: now,
  };

  memoryProducts.unshift(newProduct);
  saveToFile(PRODUCTS_FILE, memoryProducts);
  return newProduct;
}

export function updateDefaultMarkupAdmin(newMarkup: number): { updatedCount: number; newMarkup: number } {
  memorySettings.defaultMarkup = Number(newMarkup);
  saveToFile(SETTINGS_FILE, memorySettings);

  // Recalculate selling price for all products that don't have a custom override
  let updatedCount = 0;
  memoryProducts = memoryProducts.map((p) => {
    if (p.custom_markup === null || p.custom_markup === undefined) {
      updatedCount++;
      return {
        ...p,
        selling_price: calculateSellingPrice(p.supplier_cost, memorySettings.defaultMarkup),
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    }
    return p;
  });

  saveToFile(PRODUCTS_FILE, memoryProducts);
  return { updatedCount, newMarkup: memorySettings.defaultMarkup };
}

export function deleteProductAdmin(id: string): boolean {
  const initLen = memoryProducts.length;
  memoryProducts = memoryProducts.filter((p) => p.id !== id);
  if (memoryProducts.length !== initLen) {
    saveToFile(PRODUCTS_FILE, memoryProducts);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function getAllOrdersAdmin(): Order[] {
  return memoryOrders;
}

export function updateOrderStatusAdmin(params: {
  orderNumber: string;
  status: OrderStatus;
  paymentStatus?: "unpaid" | "paid" | "failed" | "refunded";
  razorpayOrderId?: string;
  razorpayPaymentId?: string;
  razorpaySignature?: string;
  paymentMethod?: string;
  supplierOrderRef?: string;
  trackingNumber?: string;
  courierPartner?: string;
  actualShippingCost?: number;
}): Order | null {
  const idx = memoryOrders.findIndex((o) => o.order_number === params.orderNumber);
  if (idx === -1) return null;

  const current = memoryOrders[idx];
  const newPaymentStatus =
    params.paymentStatus || (params.status === "paid" ? "paid" : current.payment_status);

  const updated: Order = {
    ...current,
    status: params.status,
    payment_status: newPaymentStatus,
    razorpay_order_id:
      params.razorpayOrderId !== undefined ? params.razorpayOrderId : current.razorpay_order_id,
    razorpay_payment_id:
      params.razorpayPaymentId !== undefined ? params.razorpayPaymentId : current.razorpay_payment_id,
    razorpay_signature:
      params.razorpaySignature !== undefined ? params.razorpaySignature : current.razorpay_signature,
    payment_method:
      params.paymentMethod !== undefined ? params.paymentMethod : current.payment_method,
    supplier_order_ref:
      params.supplierOrderRef !== undefined ? params.supplierOrderRef : current.supplier_order_ref,
    tracking_number:
      params.trackingNumber !== undefined ? params.trackingNumber : current.tracking_number,
    courier_partner:
      params.courierPartner !== undefined ? params.courierPartner : current.courier_partner,
    actual_shipping_cost:
      params.actualShippingCost !== undefined ? params.actualShippingCost : current.actual_shipping_cost,
    tracking_url: params.trackingNumber
      ? `https://track.thepearlpetals.in/${params.trackingNumber}`
      : current.tracking_url,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  memoryOrders[idx] = updated;
  saveToFile(ORDERS_FILE, memoryOrders);
  return updated;
}

export function getAllSuppliersAdmin(): Supplier[] {
  return memorySuppliers;
}

export function saveSupplierAdmin(supplier: Omit<Supplier, "id" | "created_at"> & { id?: string }): Supplier {
  const isUpdate = Boolean(supplier.id);
  if (isUpdate && supplier.id) {
    const idx = memorySuppliers.findIndex((s) => s.id === supplier.id);
    if (idx !== -1) {
      memorySuppliers[idx] = {
        ...memorySuppliers[idx],
        ...supplier,
      };
      saveToFile(SUPPLIERS_FILE, memorySuppliers);
      return memorySuppliers[idx];
    }
  }

  const newSupplier: Supplier = {
    ...supplier,
    id: `sup-${Date.now()}`,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  memorySuppliers.push(newSupplier);
  saveToFile(SUPPLIERS_FILE, memorySuppliers);
  return newSupplier;
}

export function addSubscriber(email: string): { success: boolean; code: string; message: string } {
  const cleanEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const exists = memorySubscribers.find((s) => s.email === cleanEmail);
  if (exists) {
    return { success: true, code: exists.code, message: "Welcome back! Your 10% welcome code is active." };
  }

  const code = "WELCOME10";
  memorySubscribers.push({
    email: cleanEmail,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    code,
  });
  saveToFile(SUBSCRIBERS_FILE, memorySubscribers);
  return { success: true, code, message: "Welcome to Petal & Pearl! Use code WELCOME10 for 10% off." };
}

export function getSubscribersAdmin() {
  return memorySubscribers;
}

export function getStoreSettings(): PricingSettings {
  return memorySettings;
}

export function getFinancialOverviewAdmin() {
  const totalOrders = memoryOrders.length;
  const paidOrders = memoryOrders.filter((o) => o.payment_status === "paid" || o.status !== "pending_payment");
  
  const totalRevenue = paidOrders.reduce((acc, o) => acc + o.total_payable, 0);
  const totalSupplierCost = paidOrders.reduce((acc, o) => acc + o.total_supplier_cost, 0);
  const totalCustomerShippingPaid = paidOrders.reduce((acc, o) => acc + o.shipping_fee, 0);
  
  // Expenses calculation
  const totalActualShippingExpenses = paidOrders.reduce((acc, o) => acc + (o.actual_shipping_cost || 65), 0);
  const totalGatewayCharges = Math.round(totalRevenue * 0.0236 * 100) / 100; // 2.36% (2% + 18% GST)
  const packagingExpenses = paidOrders.length * 25; // ₹25 per luxury boutique box
  
  const netContribution = Math.round(
    (totalRevenue - totalSupplierCost - totalActualShippingExpenses - totalGatewayCharges - packagingExpenses) * 100
  ) / 100;

  const contributionMarginPercent = totalRevenue > 0 
    ? Math.round((netContribution / totalRevenue) * 10000) / 100 
    : 0;

  return {
    totalOrders,
    paidOrdersCount: paidOrders.length,
    totalRevenue,
    totalSupplierCost,
    totalCustomerShippingPaid,
    totalActualShippingExpenses,
    totalGatewayCharges,
    packagingExpenses,
    netContribution,
    contributionMarginPercent,
    currentDefaultMarkup: memorySettings.defaultMarkup,
  };
}

-- ==============================================================================
-- PETAL & PEARL — PRODUCTION SUPABASE POSTGRESQL SCHEMA & ROW LEVEL SECURITY
-- Domain: https://thepearlpetals.in
-- Brand: Petal & Pearl
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. EXTENSIONS
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- 2. STORE SETTINGS
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS store_settings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    default_markup NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 100.00,
    free_shipping_threshold NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 999.00,
    flat_shipping_fee NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 99.00,
    announcement_bar_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Complimentary boutique packaging on all prepaid orders | Free shipping over ₹999',
    is_live_payments_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 3. PROFILES (Linked to Supabase Auth)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    full_name TEXT,
    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 4. ADMIN USERS (Role-Based Access Control)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin' CHECK (role IN ('superadmin', 'admin', 'fulfilment_manager')),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 5. CATEGORIES & SUBCATEGORIES
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS categories (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,
    image_url TEXT,
    display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subcategories (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    category_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    slug TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(category_id, slug)
);

-- 6. SUPPLIERS (With Resale Authorization Tracking)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS suppliers (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_email TEXT,
    contact_phone TEXT,
    website_url TEXT,
    resale_permission_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_agreement' 
        CHECK (resale_permission_status IN ('verified_wholesale', 'pending_agreement', 'not_authorized')),
    agreement_notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 7. PRODUCTS (Dynamic Pricing Engine)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    sku TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    slug TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    category_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    subcategory_id UUID REFERENCES subcategories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    supplier_cost NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (supplier_cost >= 0),
    selling_price NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (selling_price >= supplier_cost),
    custom_markup NUMERIC(10, 2) DEFAULT NULL,
    stock INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
    is_featured BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_bestseller BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_new BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_visible BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 8. PRODUCT IMAGES
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_images (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    image_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    alt_text TEXT,
    display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_primary BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 9. PRODUCT VARIANTS
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_variants (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    sku TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    price_override NUMERIC(10, 2) DEFAULT NULL,
    stock INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
    attributes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 10. SUPPLIER PRODUCTS (Internal Catalogue Tracking)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplier_products (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    supplier_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    supplier_sku TEXT,
    supplier_product_url TEXT,
    supplier_quoted_price NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    lead_time_days INT DEFAULT 3,
    last_checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 11. INVENTORY
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    variant_id UUID REFERENCES product_variants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    current_stock INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reserved_stock INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    low_stock_threshold INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
    reorder_status TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (reorder_status IN ('normal', 'low', 'reorder_placed')),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 12. CARTS & CART ITEMS
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS carts (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    session_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cart_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    cart_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES carts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    variant_id UUID REFERENCES product_variants(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (quantity > 0),
    price_at_addition NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 13. ORDERS
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    order_number TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    customer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    shipping_house TEXT NOT NULL,
    shipping_street TEXT NOT NULL,
    shipping_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    shipping_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    shipping_pincode TEXT NOT NULL,
    shipping_country TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'India',
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_payment' CHECK (
        status IN (
            'pending_payment',
            'paid',
            'processing',
            'supplier_order_placed',
            'shipped',
            'delivered',
            'cancelled',
            'refund_pending',
            'refunded'
        )
    ),
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unpaid' CHECK (
        payment_status IN ('unpaid', 'paid', 'failed', 'refunded')
    ),
    subtotal NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    shipping_fee NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    discount_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    total_payable NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    total_supplier_cost NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    total_contribution NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    customer_notes TEXT,
    internal_admin_notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 14. ORDER ITEMS

    id,
    sku,
    name,
    slug,
    category_id,
    subcategory_id,
    description,
    selling_price,
    stock,
    is_featured,
    is_bestseller,
    is_new,
    is_visible,
    tags,
    created_at,
    updated_at
FROM products
WHERE is_visible = true;

-- Helper function to check if current user is an admin
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_admin()
RETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM admin_users
        WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
    );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- Categories & Subcategories: Public can read, Admins can write
CREATE POLICY "Public can view categories" ON categories FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage categories" ON categories FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

CREATE POLICY "Public can view subcategories" ON subcategories FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage subcategories" ON subcategories FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

-- Store Settings: Public can read, Admins can edit
CREATE POLICY "Public can view store settings" ON store_settings FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Admins can update store settings" ON store_settings FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

-- Products & Product Images: Public can view visible, Admins can do all
CREATE POLICY "Public can view visible products" ON products FOR SELECT USING (is_visible = true);
CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage products" ON products FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

CREATE POLICY "Public can view product images" ON product_images FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage product images" ON product_images FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

CREATE POLICY "Public can view product variants" ON product_variants FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage product variants" ON product_variants FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

-- Admin-only tables: suppliers, supplier_products, inventory, expenses
CREATE POLICY "Admin only access suppliers" ON suppliers FOR ALL USING (is_admin());
CREATE POLICY "Admin only access supplier_products" ON supplier_products FOR ALL USING (is_admin());
CREATE POLICY "Admin only access inventory" ON inventory FOR ALL USING (is_admin());
CREATE POLICY "Admin only access expenses" ON expenses FOR ALL USING (is_admin());
CREATE POLICY "Admin only access admin_users" ON admin_users FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

-- Carts: Users or sessions manage their own cart
CREATE POLICY "Users can manage own cart" ON carts FOR ALL USING (
    (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() = user_id) OR (session_id IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE POLICY "Users can manage own cart items" ON cart_items FOR ALL USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM carts WHERE carts.id = cart_items.cart_id AND (
            (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() = carts.user_id) OR (carts.session_id IS NOT NULL)
        )
    )
);

-- Orders: Customers read own orders, Admin can view/edit all
CREATE POLICY "Customers can view own orders" ON orders FOR SELECT USING (
    (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() = user_id) OR is_admin()
);
CREATE POLICY "Allow order creation during checkout" ON orders FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "Admins can update orders" ON orders FOR UPDATE USING (is_admin());

CREATE POLICY "Customers can view own order items" ON order_items FOR SELECT USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE orders.id = order_items.order_id AND (
            (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() = orders.user_id) OR is_admin()
        )
    )
);
CREATE POLICY "Allow order items creation during checkout" ON order_items FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);

-- Payments & Shipments: Customers view own, Admins manage
CREATE POLICY "View payments for own orders" ON payments FOR SELECT USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE orders.id = payments.order_id AND (
            (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() = orders.user_id) OR is_admin()
        )
    )
);
CREATE POLICY "Admins manage payments" ON payments FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

CREATE POLICY "View shipments for own orders" ON shipments FOR SELECT USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE orders.id = shipments.order_id AND (
            (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid() = orders.user_id) OR is_admin()
        )
    )
);
CREATE POLICY "Admins manage shipments" ON shipments FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

-- Newsletter: Anyone can subscribe, Admin can view
CREATE POLICY "Anyone can subscribe to newsletter" ON newsletter_subscribers FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "Admins can view newsletter subscribers" ON newsletter_subscribers FOR SELECT USING (is_admin());
